55daedbf.title: Pre Sales Solutions Engineer
55daedbf.description:
**Brennan. Where true performance thrives.**
At Brennan, we believe that
*how*
technology is delivered is every bit as important as
*what*
the technology is. We focus on creating real and relevant value for customers with solutions that fit their specific needs and always reflect their true interests. It’s a claim backed by our
**True Performance System**
- a way of working engineered to get us closer, and deliver better, for our customers and their actual experience of technology.
  
  
**Why join Brennan**
True performance for our customers starts with a true belief in our people.
  
  
It’s why we’ve structured our business to help our teams, and their talents, shine bright. It's why we’ve created a workplace where people of all backgrounds, beliefs and experiences are welcomed and empowered. And it’s why we’ve built an organisation where real innovation makes a genuine impact and generates true rewards for our team members.
  
  
**True rewards**
In addition to competitive remuneration, Brennan offers extensive benefits, including:
  
  

* Training and certification bonuses
* Culture Awards that recognise excellence
* Brennan Daredevils - our annual, all-expenses paid trip awarded to our top performers and outstanding contributors
* Vibrant, fun social activities
* Discounted hardware and software
* An environment that embraces learning and development

**PURPOSE OF ROLE**
The Presales Solutions Engineer is a technical-sales focused professional responsible for growing revenue across the Brennan IT portfolio. As a Presales Solutions Engineer you will be responsible for providing pre-sales technical consulting expertise to assist Brennan IT winning new and retaining existing business.
  
  
The Presales Solutions Engineer core role is to provide pre-sales technical insights, solution design and solution support to the Australia Based Pre Sales Team and existing Brennan customers.
  
  
Presales Solutions Engineer will assist in developing technical solutions for existing customers with regards to Managed Services, Hybrid Cloud (IaaS, Azure, AWS), Modern Workplace (M365), Networking & Security and SDWAN. This role will also involve the development of customer facing artifacts, Work Breakdown Structures and Statements of Work (SOW) and the Individual must have the ability to follow the Internal processes for sign off and approvals prior to releasing documentation to the customer.
  
  
An individual who has a generalist technical background with ability a proven ability to problem solve will be key to being successful in this role. A successful Presales Solutions Engineer must also have the ability to understand the customer requirement, develop task based breakdown structures coupled with effort estimations in line with customer outcomes, and collaborate with the Pre Sales Architecture Community to develop and recommend solutions.
  
  
As a Presales Solutions Engineer you will
  
  

* Have an attention to detail and provide a high standard of technical solution design to clients and create SOWs
* Ability to think outside the box when scoping and solutioning outcomes In line with customer objectives and budget
* Support the development of Statement of Work's and follow due process for Internal sign off prior to customer release
* Ability to work across competing priorities and outcomes
* Ability to build relationships with the wider Pre Sales Architecture community and Practice Leads where required
* Support the development of proposals, presentations and technical documentation where required
* Contribute to the Product Development cycle by participating in internal and client Workshops.

**ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Working in collaboration with an Australian Based Pre Sales Architect to produce customer facing artifacts required during the sales process
* Utilising internal systems to create relevant artifacts for generation of Work Breakdown Structure, Managed Services Renewals and Variations and follow process for peer review and technical sign off
* Attending customer meetings to discuss and obtain customer requirement
* Development of a scope of work at the direction of key stakeholder
* Transcribing the technical outcomes and scope to an order form
* Owning and following the Internal process for peer review and approval prior to releasing to customer.
* Working alongside an Australian Based Pre Sale Architect to produce and develop customer artifacts required for a successful sale.
* Coordinating internal teams to inputs required to complete multi solutions proposals
* Maintain an in-depth knowledge of the company’s products and services offerings and methodologies.
* Any other task/duties aligned with your role or in support of your team as advised by your leader.
* Delivery of various pre-sales activities - including responding to customer requests for information, developing and planning conceptual solution presentations and demonstrations, technical/product guidance in meetings etc.

**KEY COMPETENCIES**

* Passion for customer service
* Excellent communication and presentation skills (verbally and in writing)
* Proven experience of scoping and developing solutions
* Experience within an IT solutions business with experience in Cloud Services and IT outsourcing / managed services
* A “trusted advisor” and “project leader” attitude
* Well organised, ability to perform and work well under pressure.
* A willingness to work and adapt to a fast growing & changing environment
* Technical understanding of IaaS and Hybrid Cloud
* Technical understanding of Microsoft Office 365 Suite of technologies including, Endpoint Management, Security and Teams
* Understanding of Cloud Connectivity, Networking and SDWAN technologies
* Understanding of AI and how to apply AI to achieve the required outcomes
* Industry based technical certifications (e.g. Microsoft, , VMWare, EMC, Cisco, HP, Sophos, Fortinet)
* Experience working with Cloud, IaaS and Hosting solutions including products such as Microsoft Azure and Office 365
* Prior experience within an outsourced service delivery environment
* Proven experience and ability to provide consultative guidance combined with previous customer facing Presales and presentation experience
* 5+ years industry experience in professional services or experience in technical service delivery roles

**Brennan**
is an equal opportunity employer.

e96d6e3e.title: Pre-Sales Manager / Solution Consultant
e96d6e3e.description:
Job Description: Pre-Sales Manager / Solution Consultant About BizAcuity

BizAcuity, founded in 2011, is a global technology consulting partner specializing in data, cloud, and AI-powered solutions. Evolving from a business intelligence firm into an engineering and AI transformation partner, BizAcuity empowers organizations to operate smarter and scale securely. Leveraging expertise in product engineering, AI, machine learning, and Generative AI, we create scalable solutions on platforms like AWS, Azure, and Snowflake.

With a strong focus on transparency, security, and ROI, BizAcuity is a trusted partner for leading global enterprises across industries such as finance, gaming, healthcare, and travel. Rated 4.8/5 on Gartner Peer Insights, we continue to drive innovation and business growth through intelligent data-driven solutions.

For more information on BizAcuity, log on to -
https://bizacuity.com/

**Job Title:**
Pre-Sales Manager/ Solution Consultant (Full Time / on BizAcuity's payroll)

**Job Mode:**
Onsite/Work from Office | Monday to Friday | Shift 1 (Morning)

**Job Location:**
Hyderabad

Job Summary:

The Pre-Sales Manager / Solution Consultant will be a key driver of new business acquisition, leveraging deep technical and business expertise to guide the sales process. This role demands a strong ability to understand complex customer challenges, architect tailored solutions, and persuasively demonstrate our product's value to prospective clients. The ideal candidate will possess a blend of technical acumen, sales aptitude, and a consultative approach to effectively translate client needs into compelling solutions.

Key Responsibilities:

**Technical Solutioning:**

* Develop and maintain in-depth technical knowledge of our products, solutions, and underlying technologies.
* Stay current with industry trends, emerging technologies, and advancements in the data analytics and business intelligence space.
* Conduct thorough needs assessments to capture detailed customer requirements, business objectives, and technical specifications.
* Architect and design innovative, tailored solutions that precisely address customer challenges and align with their strategic goals.
* Develop and deliver compelling, persuasive technical presentations and product demonstrations that showcase the value and differentiation of our solutions.
* Lead the development of Proof-of-Concept (POC)projects and customized demonstrations to validate proposed solutions and drive customer confidence.
* Provide expert technical guidance and solution recommendations throughout the sales cycle.

Collaborate closelywith product management, engineering, and support teams to ensure

proposed solutions are feasible and customer requirements are accurately captured for implementation.

Sales Skills & Customer Engagement:

* Collaborate strategically with the sales team to identify opportunities, qualify leads, and develop effective sales strategies.
* Employ a consultative sales approach to build strong relationships with prospects and customers, understand their business challenges, and position our solutions as the optimal solution.
* Effectively communicate the business value and ROI of our solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences, including C-level executives.
* Act as a trusted technical advisor and advocate for customers, building credibility and fostering long-term partnerships.
* Proactively identify and address customer concerns and objections throughout the sales process.
* Assist the sales team in preparing and delivering compelling responses to RFPs, RFIs, and technical inquiries.
* Create high-quality technical documentation, proposals, and presentations that support the sales process and effectively communicate our value proposition.

Post-Sales Transition:

* Ensure a smooth and efficient handover of new customers to the implementation and support teams.
* Maintain customer satisfaction during the onboarding process by providing ongoing support and guidance.

Qualifications:

* **Education:**
  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Information Technology, or a related field.
* Experience:
* 5+ years of experience in a pre-sales, solution consulting, or similar customer-facing technical role, preferably in the Business Intelligence or Data Analytics domain.
* Must have demonstrable experience working on projects within a BI ecosystem, including solution design, implementation, and deployment, with a focus on data warehousing, data analytics, and master data management.
* Proven track record of exceeding sales targets and driving revenue growth in a pre-sales or technical sales support role.
* Technical Skills:
* Strong understanding of software solutions, cloud technologies, and enterprise IT environments.
* Proficiency in data analytics concepts, methodologies, and technologies (e.g., SQL, data warehousing, ETL, data modeling, data mining, BI tools, data visualization, reporting, and dashboarding).
* Experience with Master Data Management (MDM) principles, practices, and tools.
* Experience with BI platforms (e.g., Tableau, PowerBI, Looker) and database systems.
* Familiarity with cloud-based data warehousing solutions (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, Big Query).

* Familiarity with relevant industry standards and technologies (e.g., SaaS, PaaS, IaaS).
* Soft Skills:
* Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively communicate complex technical concepts to diverse audiences.
* Exceptional problem-solving, analytical, and critical-thinking skills.
* Strong business acumen and a customer-centric approach.
* Ability to work independently, take initiative, and collaborate effectively within a team environment.

8dc7c266.title: Senior Solution Engineer
8dc7c266.description:
SailPoint is the leading, AI-driven security platform providing the autonomous governance that best solves the needs for the modern enterprise. SailPoint makes it possible to automate and streamline the identity journey. We marry technical expertise with business acumen to deliver identity security that will drive business forward. 

We are proud of our team and the culture we have built which has led to our employees voting us “best places to work” – 15 years in a row!

**About the Role**

SailPoint is looking for a talented, collaborative, determined, and motivated
**Senior Solution Enginee**
r to join the India team. You will be a team member of SailPoint’s presales organisation working with our sales teams to support direct and indirect sales efforts, as well as work with our partners and customers.  Your thorough understanding of Identity, Governance, User Administration, Access Management and Cyber Security, coupled with your excellent communication skills will enable you to effectively articulate the value of SailPoint solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences.  Expertise in discovering customer requirements, aligning SailPoint solutions to address identity challenges and demonstrating product capabilities is essential to success in this role.

**The Path to Success**

Becoming a successful Solution Engineer at SailPoint can be as simple as achieving 3 key milestones in 3 months – know SailPoint, know the platform, and demo the platform - with some key steps in between.

Within the first month your goals will include:

* Complete Getting started Checklist, including Pre/Post Revenue Onboarding Coursework, attending HR onboarding Sessions, access Identity University, and complete role specific suggested courses.
* Familiarise yourself with the High-level Function Org Chart; a high-level understanding of our main 5 business functions and the teams that compose them.
* Make use of all video collateral to augment onboarding training.
* Learn the SailPoint pitch.
* Meet the team – Digital Sales, your AE’s, Marketing, Channel, Sales Leadership. (Schedule intro meetings with key stakeholders as identified by your manager)
* Meet your buddy and set up Bi-weekly meetings & 1 to 1’s with your manager.
* Listen in and shadow discovery calls, presentations, demos as much as you can
* Familiarise yourself with key administrative tasks and important metrics

Within 3 months at SailPoint you will have:

* Completed all assigned training to become ‘field ready’
* Present SailPoint, platform and demo to your manager
* Continued to have periodic meetings with your buddy
* Have regular scheduled meetings with your partnering Account Executives, Digital Sales, Customer Success and Delivery Services Team.
* Ready to execute as Lead Solution Engineer
* Know the RFx response process, tools and lead your first RFx response

By the end of your first 12 months at SailPoint you will have:

* Completed your platform training and attained product certification
* Build and maintain a value driven, outcome base narrative
* Confidently engage with senior execs and articulate the business values of identity security
* Led the technical aspects of opportunities alongside your partnering Account Executives from discovery, to presentation, to demo, to evaluation and to close
* Contribute to customer success stories, white papers, blogs and social media posts that show our expertise in the Identity Security Market.
* Actively participate in internal meetings, knowledge sharing sessions and enablement
* Mentor and coach new sales and presales team members on SailPoint solution
* Be the Solution Engineering rock star you were born to be

**Requirements:**

* 5+ years professional experience as a pre-sales technical resource in an enterprise software company
* 3+ years working with Identity, Governance and Access Management solutions.
* Excellent written and verbal communications skills.
* A working knowledge of technical infrastructure including application servers, databases, virtualization and directories is required.
* Familiarity with Java, XML, LDAP, SQL is desirable.
* Understanding of Cloud platforms like Azure, Google and AWS is desirable.
* Ensure proposed deals include technical solutions that accurately address customer needs, and appropriately supported by key customer technical decision-makers.
* Lead and engage in technical conversations with customers.
* Work with Product team to improve roadmap based on technical experience with customers.
* Understand and ability to explain Identity Security processes, deployment models & best practices.

**Location:**

* Mumbai, India
* Travel is expected.

SailPoint is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome all qualified candidates to apply to join our team.  All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.  

Alternative methods of applying for employment are available to individuals unable to submit an application through this site because of a disability. Contact applicationassistance@sailpoint.com or mail to 11120 Four Points Dr, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78726, to discuss reasonable accommodations.  NOTE: Any unsolicited resumes sent by candidates or agencies to this email will not be considered for current openings at SailPoint.

2c8361ff.title: Solutions Architect (Genie)
2c8361ff.description:
FEQ327R421
  
  
**Mission**
The
**Solutions Architect (Genie)**
team executes on Databricks’ strategic Product Operating Model that provides enhanced focus on earlier stage, highly prioritized product lines in order to establish product market fit, and set the course for rapid revenue growth. They are part of a global go-to-market team mandate, though individually will cover a specific, local region. Clients may span across one or more business units and verticals. By working in partnership with direct account teams, they will jointly engage clients, foster the necessary relationships, position
*in-depth*
the specific product line, so as to provide compelling reasons for clients to adopt and grow the usage of the given product. They understand the appropriate approach, the guardrails, and the steps needed to successfully adopt the product line, as clients deliver on their business objectives.
  
  
The Solutions Architect (Genie) is paired with an Account Executive aligned to a given product line with specific targets accordingly. Together, they will devise and implement a strategy across their assigned set of accounts, develop presentations, demos and other assets and deliver them such that clients make an informed decision as they decide to adopt the product-line in a meaningful way.
  
  
**The impact you will have**

* Collaborate with GTM leadership and account teams to design and execute high-impact engagement strategies across your territory.
* As a trusted advisor, serve as an expert Solutions Architect and "champion," building technical credibility with stakeholders to drive product adoption and vision.
* Enable clients at scale through workshops and developing customer-facing collateral that helps increase technical knowledge and thought leadership.
* Influence product roadmap by translating field-derived, data-driven insights into strategic recommendations for Product and Engineering teams
* Handle the most complex technical challenges in this product line by acting as the tier-3 escalation point for the field, ensuring customer success in mission-critical environments.

**Competencies & Responsibilities**

* 6+ years in a customer-facing, pre-sales or consulting role influencing technical executives, driving high-level data strategy and product adoption.
* Credibility in influencing analytics, BI, and natural-language / agentic AI products, with the market insight needed to shape and prioritize roadmap capabilities.
* Deep understanding of AI governance across different tools and models and ability to guide customers through security blockers and concerns
* Proven ability to co-plan large territories with Account Executives and operate in a highly coordinated, cross-functional effort across GTM and R&D teams.
* Experience architecting governed analytics solutions that integrate semantic models, data warehouses, and metric layers within broader Lakehouse and AI ecosystems.
* Experience collaborating with Global System Integrators (GSIs) and third-party consulting organizations to drive customer outcomes.
* Proficient in programming, debugging, and problem-solving using SQL and Python.
* Hands-on experience building solutions within major public cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Broad experience (in two or more) and understanding across the fields of data engineering, data warehousing, business intelligence, AI, ML, governance, semantic modeling, natural-language analytics, and streaming.
* Undergraduate degree (or higher) in a technical field such as Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering or similar.

**About Databricks**

It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
  
  
Join us to put AI to work for people.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What you get to do in this role:**
  
  

* Support product sales as a technical, solution, and industry domain expert within a client-facing sales team pursuing strategic enterprise customers and prospects.
* Bring industry-specific expertise across Manufacturing, Retail, IT/ITES, and/or Telecommunications, with the ability to understand industry operating models, customer journeys, service operations, business processes, technology landscapes, and transformation priorities.
* Translate industry challenges into compelling solution narratives by connecting business outcomes, customer experience, workflow transformation, automation, data, and AI with ServiceNow capabilities.
* Lead executive and technical discovery workshops to uncover customer priorities, operational challenges, transformation opportunities, and desired business outcomes.
* Develop and deliver compelling product demonstrations and solution experiences that reflect real industry scenarios and end-to-end business processes, rather than feature-led demonstrations.
* Engage credibly with senior business stakeholders, CIO/CTO/CBO organizations, enterprise architects, operations leaders, and transformation teams.
* Develop strong client and partner relationships and establish yourself as a trusted advisor throughout the sales cycle.
* Develop solution architectures that demonstrate how ServiceNow integrates with a customer's broader enterprise technology ecosystem, including CRM, ERP, contact center, data, integration, and AI platforms.
* Articulate the role of AI, Agentic AI, automation, workflow orchestration, and data in transforming industry-specific processes and customer experiences.
* Stay current on competitive positioning, industry trends, emerging technology, AI developments, and market differentiation.
* Represent ServiceNow at executive briefings, customer workshops, conferences, industry forums, user groups, partner events, and trade shows.

**Qualifications**

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers based in Ottawa, Canada. We are expanding our team in Chennai and around the world as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Building a high-trust and high-performance culture is important to us and we are proud to be Great Place to Work® Certified TM . Our state-of-the-art office, located in the World Trade Centre in Chennai, offers our growing team space for expansion and collaboration.
  
  
**Location**
Chennai, India
  
  
**About The Team**
As a member of our Consulting Team, you understand our customers’ most pressing business performance challenges and you are committed to helping our customers solve complex challenges in the distributed value chain that is prevalent in manufacturing today.
  
  
****What you will do****

* Participate in in the end-to-end deployment of production scheduling tool including deep-dive customer business requirements discovery sessions and develop requirements specifications documentation.
* Collaborates closely with agile team members to support the configuration, implementation of Maestro software to enable the solution according to our customers distinct needs
* Translate business requirements into Kinaxis Maestro software specifications, following supply chain industry trends and best practices.
* Support senior team members in providing creative solutions to complex business problems while maintaining best practices.
* Participate in data management and data integration activities, including source systems data transformation, data loading, data cleanup and validation.
* Perform training of customer end users on the configured solution.
* Provide technical support to end users and resolve issues of the configured solutions, escalating to senior team members as needed.
* Support the validation and testing of the solution and capture user feedback.
* Actively engage, guide and mentor to develop the skills of junior consultants on projects.
* Any other reasonable project related tasks as assigned by the Project Manager.

****What we are looking for****

* Candidates with results-oriented mindset, focusing on improving client satisfaction and providing a very high standard of service, driving towards Kinaxis’s success.
* Sound knowledge in Supply Chain concepts especially scheduling with 6+ years of experience.
* Strong intent to learn our first in class product “Maestro”
* Work in a fast-paced project environment and co-ordinate with members at all levels in an organization
* Highly adaptable professional, able to embrace teamwork in diverse and evolving work environments.
* Capability to lead by example, having the drive to think in an innovative way and have passion about new challenges
* Ability to solve complex problems, think critically and make sound judgement decisions.
* A passion for working in customer facing roles that require high level of interpersonal, communication, facilitation and presentation skills.
* Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively in English, both verbally and in writing
* Technical skills such as SQL, R, Java Script, Python, etc.
* Experience with manufacturing planning solutions such as Kinaxis, SAP, JDA, etc. is an added advantage

#Senior
  
  
**Work With Impact:**
Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day—when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
  
  
**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:**
Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Ford, Unilever, Yamaha, P&G, Lockheed-Martin, and more.
  
  
**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:**
Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to net-zero operations strategy for the long term. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
  
  
People matter at Kinaxis and these are some of the perks and benefits we created for our team:
  
  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide day off on the last Friday of every month)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs and training and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis web site at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .
  
  
Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. Please note that this contact information is strictly for accessibility requests and cannot be used to inquire about application statuses.
  
  
Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

**Join Wand in leading the Agentic Shift**
Wand is building a high-performing global team who take full ownership of what they build. We lead by example, move fast, make data-aware decisions, and continuously push for more- always with a focus on delivering real value to customers.
  
  
You would be joining a world-class team that combines deep research expertise and real-world product execution, with experience spanning Deepmind, Google, Amazon, Miro, Elise AI, IBM and Accern.
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Field Solutions Engineer to sit at the intersection of engineering and go-to-market: pairing deep hands-on building with direct customer work to turn Wand’s platform into real agent-hours, workflows, and value in production.
  
  
You’ll work across the lifecycle from early technical validation and pilots through rollout and adoption translating messy business problems into concrete, testable workflows, building believable prototypes, and helping customers scale usage across many use cases.
  
  
If you love writing Python, wiring up APIs, and experimenting with LLMs as much as you enjoy talking to customers, this is a chance to shape how enterprises actually adopt the next generation of AI systems.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**
*Build and ship real solutions*

* Design and implement workflows, agents, and integrations on Wand for live customer scenarios (not just demo toys).
* Turn one-off builds into reusable patterns: templates, starter kits, and internal tools other CEs/SEs can reuse.
* Own technical quality: performance, reliability, and auditability of what you ship.

*﻿Lead technical validation (“Proof-to-Contract”)*

* Help customers frame clear technical hypotheses: what needs to be proven (accuracy, coverage, latency, safety) for them to buy.
* Design lightweight proofs, benchmarks, and evals that credibly answer, “Does this actually work for our data and process?”
* Set up simple measurement for before/after: time saved, error reduction, or volume handled.

*﻿Support pre-sales and pilots*

* Partner with Sales to shape and deliver believable demos and pilots that showcase Wand’s differentiators (agentic workflows, governance, complex document workflows, etc.).
* Adapt and extend our demo environments rather than rebuilding from scratch each time.
* Join customer calls to explain how things work under the hood and handle deep technical questions.

*﻿Drive onboarding, adoption, and expansion*

* Help design and run onboarding plans: initial workflows, training sessions, office hours, and enablement for power users.
* Instrument your solutions for usage and value (DAU/WAU, agent-hours, workflow runs) and use this data to guide iteration.
* Partner with Customer Success to identify new use cases and turn proven workflows into broader rollouts.

*﻿Handle issues with urgency*

* Debug and triage customer-facing issues, working closely with core Engineering when needed.
* Provide clear, customer-ready explanations, workarounds, and follow-ups.
* Feed recurring issues back into platform fixes, docs, and playbooks.

*﻿Build the CE toolbox and playbooks*

* Contribute Python scripts, API workflows, and reference architectures that show “the Wand way” to build.
* Document patterns for common use cases (e.g., contract review, research copilots, support augmentation) so the next deployment is faster.
* Help define and refine internal CE rituals: intake criteria, pilot checklists, and demo/pilot templates.

**﻿Key Qualifications:**

* 5+ years in a hands-on technical role such as Sales Engineer, Solutions Architect, Customer/Field Engineer, or Product-adjacent Engineer, working directly with enterprise customers.

Strong
**practical engineering skills**
:
  
  

* Comfortable writing Python in a professional context (scripts, services, ETL, automation).
* Experience integrating with APIs, webhooks, and data sources (files, DBs, SaaS tools).
* Able to design simple, robust systems and debug real-world failures.
* Experience building with LLMs or applied AI systems:
* Prompting, RAG, or agent/workflow orchestration (homegrown or with tools like LangChain, LlamaIndex, etc.).
* You’ve shipped at least one real application, prototype, or internal tool that used an LLM or similar model in production or a serious pilot.

Comfortable in front of customers:
  
  

* Can walk through an architecture diagram, show live workflows, and answer hard questions without hand-waving.
* Can listen deeply, translate fuzzy asks into concrete technical work, and push back when a request doesn’t make sense.
* Demonstrated ability to work across the lifecycle: discovery/solution design, proof/pilot build, rollout, and post-launch iteration.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**﻿Who You Are:**
**Builder First, Then Storyteller**
You reach for a REPL or notebook before a slide. You’re happiest when you can show, not just tell — but you can narrate clearly for both engineers and executives.
  
  
**Customer-Obsessed Problem Solver**
You care less about “cool tech” and more about whether the workflow actually saves time, reduces risk, or lets the customer do something genuinely new.
  
  
**Hands-On and Pragmatic**
You’re comfortable with ambiguity and partial requirements. You find the smallest credible thing to build that proves the point and moves the deal or deployment forward.
  
  
**Systems Thinker**
You see how pre-sales, pilots, adoption, support, and metrics fit together and look for ways to turn one success into a pattern others can reuse.
  
  
**Bias to Action and Ownership**
You don’t wait for perfect specs. You pick up the ball, talk to whoever you need to, and get the workflow, demo, or fix over the line — then you document it so it’s easier next time.

edf1701c.title: Solution Architect
edf1701c.location: Noida, Greater Noida, Delhi / NCR, India
edf1701c.description:
We are seeking an experienced and technically proficient **Solution Architect** to lead the end-to-end solution design and upgrade strategy for **UDM (User Data Management), IMS (IP Multimedia Subsystem), and Packet Core** network elements. The architect will collaborate with cross-functional teams to define upgrade paths, validate design impacts, and ensure seamless execution in live network environments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* **Upgrade Strategy & Planning**:

+ Define upgrade approach (ISSU vs. redeployment) based on product capabilities and customer environment.
+ Evaluate backward compatibility and interoperability impacts across EPC/5GC/Cloud components.
+ Align upgrade activities with network architecture roadmap, lifecycle policies, and vendor release cycles.

* **Solution Architecture & Design**:

+ Develop high- and low-level solution architecture for upgrades, including software/hardware pre-requisites.
+ Create detailed upgrade impact assessments and rollback strategies.
+ Validate upgrade path for clustered/HA deployments, geo-redundancy, and distributed architectures.

* **Stakeholder Coordination**:

+ Work with delivery, operations, product teams, and customers to gather requirements and constraints.
+ Participate in technical governance and change control boards for upgrade approvals.
+ Present solution documents, risk mitigations, and test validation plans to internal and external stakeholders.

* **Tools, Automation & Compliance**:

+ Leverage automation for pre-checks, health-checks, and post-upgrade validation (e.g., EVFNM, CaaS scripts).
+ Ensure compliance with security, data protection, and audit standards during upgrade cycles.
+ Integrate solutions with CI/CD pipelines where applicable.

* **Documentation & Knowledge Sharing**:

+ Develop and maintain architecture documentation, upgrade playbooks, and decision logs.
+ Share knowledge across teams via technical sessions, mentoring, and documentation.

**Required Skills & Experience:**

* **Telecom Domain Expertise**:

+ Deep understanding of UDM (HSS, UDR, UDSF, AUSF), IMS (CSCF, TAS, MGCF), and Packet Core (MME, SGW, PGW, AMF, SMF, UPF) in EPC/5GC networks.
+ Proven experience in at least **2-3 large-scale upgrade projects** involving these domains.

* **Technical Skills**:

+ Familiarity with virtualization (VMware, OpenStack) and containerization platforms (Kubernetes, Docker, CaaS).
+ Competence in scripting (Python, Bash, Ansible) for automation.
+ Experience with integration and deployment tools like Git, Jenkins, Helm is a plus.

* **Design & Analysis**:

+ Strong grasp of system interdependencies, signaling flows (Diameter, SIP, HTTP2, GTP), and failover mechanisms.
+ Ability to conduct impact analysis across interfaces (Nxx, Sxx, Gx, Rx, etc.).

* **Soft Skills**:

+ Excellent communication and stakeholder management.
+ Analytical mindset and problem-solving orientation.

ea8436c7.title: Salesforce Technical Architect- Automotive Cloud
ea8436c7.description:
**Description**
**What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters**
The Technical Architect — Automotive Cloud successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex, enterprise-grade Salesforce solutions for automotive clients operating across OEMs, authorized dealership networks, commercial fleet operators, and emerging mobility providers. Technologies include Salesforce Automotive Cloud, Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, Fleet Management, Salesforce APIs, Apex/LWC, Agentforce, and DMS/telematics integrations.
  
  
You are both a big-picture automotive enterprise thinker and a deep, hands-on problem solver. You take pride in designing systems that withstand high transaction volumes across distributed dealer networks, support complex OEM-to-dealer data hierarchies, and will not fail at critical inflection points such as vehicle launch campaigns, service recall operations, or connected vehicle data ingestion spikes. The solutions you design are built for long-term scalability, growing seamlessly alongside the customer's dealer network footprint and connected vehicle ecosystem.
  
  
You have a strong mix of technical depth and enterprise consulting acumen, knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality, accelerate architectural design cycles, and rapidly prototype automotive-specific configurations. As Salesforce leads the agentic era, you play a front-line role in driving AI-First delivery—designing autonomous agents that power intelligent dealer assist, predictive service scheduling, and connected vehicle conversational experiences.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
**Stakeholder Collaboration:**
Collaborate with automotive client stakeholders—CTO, VP Digital, Head of Dealer Operations—to define requirements, deliverables, and manage expectations across enterprise OEM and dealer network engagements.
  
  
**Solution Architecture:**
Translate complex automotive business requirements into well-architected Salesforce solutions, identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI using Agentforce for intelligent dealer assist, predictive service agents, and connected vehicle conversational experiences.
  
  
**Enterprise AI Architecture:**
Design and integrate scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within Automotive Cloud environments—optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits to support real-time telematics ingestion and high-volume dealer operations.
  
  
**Technical Design Leadership:**
Lead design sessions; author TDDs/ADDs aligned to client commercial objectives; leverage AI tools to review architectural assumptions and simulate edge cases such as peak vehicle launch traffic, concurrent DMS sync operations, and large-scale recall campaign orchestration.
  
  
**AI-First Governance & Code Standards:**
Provide project oversight championing AI-First delivery using AI tools and agentic evaluation frameworks. Lead code reviews and enforce standards using AI coding assistants to identify governor limit risks and optimize integration performance.
  
  
**Technical Delivery Management:**
Manage delivery of custom development, DMS integrations, telematics ingestion pipelines, and vehicle master data migrations—using AI tools to accelerate Apex class generation, mock data creation, and REST integration scaffolding
  
  
**Performance Evaluation & ROI:**
Collaborate with automotive customers to develop evaluation frameworks measuring AI performance, dealer satisfaction scores, service retention rates, and business value for specific automotive use cases.
  
  
**Pre-Sales & Prototyping:**
Participate in automotive discovery workshops, technical deep-dives, and rapid POC development—using AI tools to prototype Vehicle Console configurations, dealer portal experiences, and Agentforce automotive agents for prospective clients.
  
  
**Product Team Liaison:**
Liaise with Salesforce Automotive Cloud product teams to channel client implementation feedback, influence roadmap decisions, and ensure implementations align with platform evolution.
  
  
**You're Our Person If...**
**Experience & Platform Depth**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience (extracurricular leadership, military, volunteer, work experience)
* 9–14 years CRM/enterprise software; 6+ years Salesforce platform; 3+ years Automotive Cloud
* Expert Automotive Cloud data model: Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, Fleet Management modules
* Expert-level Salesforce platform suite: Sales, Service, Experience, Automotive Cloud, Agentforce architecture
* Scalable solution design for high-volume automotive scenarios with AI-assisted load modeling
* LDV limitations, design patterns, and data distribution risk analysis
* Multi-tier dealer hierarchy sharing: OWD, sharing rules, and permission sets for OEM/dealer data isolation
* Platform security capabilities: TLS, SSL, and data encryption for automotive commercial data

**Integration, AI & DevOps**

* Expert DMS integration: CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Tekion; telematics ingestion platforms; OEM proprietary back-end systems
* Middleware platforms: MuleSoft, Boomi, Azure Integration Services; ETL/ELT frameworks
* Auth patterns: SAML, SSO, OAuth 2.0 — secure configuration for OEM and dealership enterprise identity providers
* DevOps: environment management, Git, Copado/Gearset, multi-sandbox deployment pipelines and release management
* Practical fluency: accelerate delivery using AI tools, document architecture, maintain code quality
* Agentforce design: dealer assist agents, connected vehicle chatbots, predictive service recommendations, intelligent recall orchestration
* Collaboration with customers to develop AI performance and business value evaluation frameworks

**Certification Pathway & Continuous Learning**
**Required Certification**
Salesforce Administrator
  
  
Platform App Builder
  
  
Platform Developer I
  
  
Agentforce Specialist
  
  
Integration Architect
  
  
Sharing & Visibility Designer
  
  
**Preferred Certification**
System / Application Architect
  
  
CRM Analytics Consultant
  
  
**Leadership Qualities & Core Values**
To navigate high-stakes technical environments and successfully lead automotive enterprises through digital disruption, the Technical Architect must embody specific consulting behaviors that translate technical capability into executive alignment and customer trust.
  
  
**Core Leadership Pillars**

* PASSION: Customer Success First : Deep personal investment in transforming complex OEM and dealer implementations into tangible market wins and measurable outcomes for automotive clients and their networks.
* BEGINNER'S MIND: Continuous Learning : Approaches every engagement with humbleness and curiosity—dismantling assumptions to keep pace with rapid shifts in EV transitions, connected vehicle technology, and consumer expectations.
* ADAPTABLE: Thrives in Uncertainty: Remains poised, agile, and decisive navigating structural volatility, shifting regulatory landscapes, and market disruption as permanent constants in the automotive sector.

**About Salesforce**
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters**
The Technical Architect — Automotive Cloud successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex, enterprise-grade Salesforce solutions for automotive clients operating across OEMs, authorized dealership networks, commercial fleet operators, and emerging mobility providers. Technologies include Salesforce Automotive Cloud, Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, Fleet Management, Salesforce APIs, Apex/LWC, Agentforce, and DMS/telematics integrations.
  
  
You are both a big-picture automotive enterprise thinker and a deep, hands-on problem solver. You take pride in designing systems that withstand high transaction volumes across distributed dealer networks, support complex OEM-to-dealer data hierarchies, and will not fail at critical inflection points such as vehicle launch campaigns, service recall operations, or connected vehicle data ingestion spikes. The solutions you design are built for long-term scalability, growing seamlessly alongside the customer's dealer network footprint and connected vehicle ecosystem.
  
  
You have a strong mix of technical depth and enterprise consulting acumen, knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality, accelerate architectural design cycles, and rapidly prototype automotive-specific configurations. As Salesforce leads the agentic era, you play a front-line role in driving AI-First delivery—designing autonomous agents that power intelligent dealer assist, predictive service scheduling, and connected vehicle conversational experiences.
  
  
**What You'll Actually Be Doing**
**Stakeholder Collaboration:**
Collaborate with automotive client stakeholders—CTO, VP Digital, Head of Dealer Operations—to define requirements, deliverables, and manage expectations across enterprise OEM and dealer network engagements.
  
  
**Solution Architecture:**
Translate complex automotive business requirements into well-architected Salesforce solutions, identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI using Agentforce for intelligent dealer assist, predictive service agents, and connected vehicle conversational experiences.
  
  
**Enterprise AI Architecture:**
Design and integrate scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within Automotive Cloud environments—optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits to support real-time telematics ingestion and high-volume dealer operations.
  
  
**Technical Design Leadership:**
Lead design sessions; author TDDs/ADDs aligned to client commercial objectives; leverage AI tools to review architectural assumptions and simulate edge cases such as peak vehicle launch traffic, concurrent DMS sync operations, and large-scale recall campaign orchestration.
  
  
**AI-First Governance & Code Standards:**
Provide project oversight championing AI-First delivery using AI tools and agentic evaluation frameworks. Lead code reviews and enforce standards using AI coding assistants to identify governor limit risks and optimize integration performance.
  
  
**Technical Delivery Management:**
Manage delivery of custom development, DMS integrations, telematics ingestion pipelines, and vehicle master data migrations—using AI tools to accelerate Apex class generation, mock data creation, and REST integration scaffolding
  
  
**Performance Evaluation & ROI:**
Collaborate with automotive customers to develop evaluation frameworks measuring AI performance, dealer satisfaction scores, service retention rates, and business value for specific automotive use cases.
  
  
**Pre-Sales & Prototyping:**
Participate in automotive discovery workshops, technical deep-dives, and rapid POC development—using AI tools to prototype Vehicle Console configurations, dealer portal experiences, and Agentforce automotive agents for prospective clients.
  
  
**Product Team Liaison:**
Liaise with Salesforce Automotive Cloud product teams to channel client implementation feedback, influence roadmap decisions, and ensure implementations align with platform evolution.

**Experience & Platform Depth**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience (extracurricular leadership, military, volunteer, work experience)
* 9–14 years CRM/enterprise software; 6+ years Salesforce platform; 3+ years Automotive Cloud
* Expert Automotive Cloud data model: Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, Fleet Management modules
* Expert-level Salesforce platform suite: Sales, Service, Experience, Automotive Cloud, Agentforce architecture
* Scalable solution design for high-volume automotive scenarios with AI-assisted load modeling
* LDV limitations, design patterns, and data distribution risk analysis
* Multi-tier dealer hierarchy sharing: OWD, sharing rules, and permission sets for OEM/dealer data isolation
* Platform security capabilities: TLS, SSL, and data encryption for automotive commercial data

**Integration, AI & DevOps**

* Expert DMS integration: CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Tekion; telematics ingestion platforms; OEM proprietary back-end systems
* Middleware platforms: MuleSoft, Boomi, Azure Integration Services; ETL/ELT frameworks
* Auth patterns: SAML, SSO, OAuth 2.0 — secure configuration for OEM and dealership enterprise identity providers
* DevOps: environment management, Git, Copado/Gearset, multi-sandbox deployment pipelines and release management
* Practical fluency: accelerate delivery using AI tools, document architecture, maintain code quality
* Agentforce design: dealer assist agents, connected vehicle chatbots, predictive service recommendations, intelligent recall orchestration
* Collaboration with customers to develop AI performance and business value evaluation frameworks

**Certification Pathway & Continuous Learning**
**Required Certification**
Salesforce Administrator
  
  
Platform App Builder
  
  
Platform Developer I
  
  
Agentforce Specialist
  
  
Integration Architect
  
  
Sharing & Visibility Designer
  
  
**Preferred Certification**
System / Application Architect
  
  
CRM Analytics Consultant
  
  
**Leadership Qualities & Core Values**
To navigate high-stakes technical environments and successfully lead automotive enterprises through digital disruption, the Technical Architect must embody specific consulting behaviors that translate technical capability into executive alignment and customer trust.
  
  
**Core Leadership Pillars**

* PASSION: Customer Success First : Deep personal investment in transforming complex OEM and dealer implementations into tangible market wins and measurable outcomes for automotive clients and their networks.
* BEGINNER'S MIND: Continuous Learning : Approaches every engagement with humbleness and curiosity—dismantling assumptions to keep pace with rapid shifts in EV transitions, connected vehicle technology, and consumer expectations.
* ADAPTABLE: Thrives in Uncertainty: Remains poised, agile, and decisive navigating structural volatility, shifting regulatory landscapes, and market disruption as permanent constants in the automotive sector.

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a Senior Cloud Ops Engineer to manage and improve our cloud infrastructure, security, and platform engineering capabilities across GCP and AWS.

The role involves designing secure and scalable cloud environments, managing Kubernetes platforms, automating infrastructure using Terraform, improving CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring high availability and reliability. * Strong production Kubernetes experience — cluster design, operations, and upgrades.

* Experience managing global on/offshore teams and high-impact project lifecycles.

* Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA).
* GitOps (ArgoCD/Flux) and progressive delivery experience.
* FinOps / cloud cost optimisation experience.
* Experience in regulated environments (HIPAA, SOC 2, ISO 27001).

16e1b4f6.title: Salesforce Technical Architect- Automotive Cloud
16e1b4f6.description:
*To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.*

Job Category

Customer Success

Job Details

**About Salesforce**

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

**What You'll Be Doing & Why It Matters**

The Technical Architect — Automotive Cloud successfully designs and manages the delivery of complex, enterprise-grade Salesforce solutions for automotive clients operating across OEMs, authorized dealership networks, commercial fleet operators, and emerging mobility providers. Technologies include Salesforce Automotive Cloud, Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, Fleet Management, Salesforce APIs, Apex/LWC, Agentforce, and DMS/telematics integrations.
  
You are both a big-picture automotive enterprise thinker and a deep, hands-on problem solver. You take pride in designing systems that withstand high transaction volumes across distributed dealer networks, support complex OEM-to-dealer data hierarchies, and will not fail at critical inflection points such as vehicle launch campaigns, service recall operations, or connected vehicle data ingestion spikes. The solutions you design are built for long-term scalability, growing seamlessly alongside the customer's dealer network footprint and connected vehicle ecosystem.
  
You have a strong mix of technical depth and enterprise consulting acumen, knowing how to leverage AI development tools like Claude, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot to optimize code quality, accelerate architectural design cycles, and rapidly prototype automotive-specific configurations. As Salesforce leads the agentic era, you play a front-line role in driving AI-First delivery—designing autonomous agents that power intelligent dealer assist, predictive service scheduling, and connected vehicle conversational experiences.

**What You'll Actually Be Doing:**
----------------------------------

**Stakeholder Collaboration:** Collaborate with automotive client stakeholders—CTO, VP Digital, Head of Dealer Operations—to define requirements, deliverables, and manage expectations across enterprise OEM and dealer network engagements.
  
**Solution Architecture:** Translate complex automotive business requirements into well-architected Salesforce solutions, identifying opportunities to embed autonomous AI using Agentforce for intelligent dealer assist, predictive service agents, and connected vehicle conversational experiences.
  
**Enterprise AI Architecture:** Design and integrate scalable predictive and generative AI solutions within Automotive Cloud environments—optimizing performance, resource consumption, and platform governor limits to support real-time telematics ingestion and high-volume dealer operations.
  
**Technical Design Leadership:** Lead design sessions; author TDDs/ADDs aligned to client commercial objectives; leverage AI tools to review architectural assumptions and simulate edge cases such as peak vehicle launch traffic, concurrent DMS sync operations, and large-scale recall campaign orchestration.
  
**AI-First Governance & Code Standards:** Provide project oversight championing AI-First delivery using AI tools and agentic evaluation frameworks. Lead code reviews and enforce standards using AI coding assistants to identify governor limit risks and optimize integration performance.
  
**Technical Delivery Management:** Manage delivery of custom development, DMS integrations, telematics ingestion pipelines, and vehicle master data migrations—using AI tools to accelerate Apex class generation, mock data creation, and REST integration scaffolding
  
**Performance Evaluation & ROI:** Collaborate with automotive customers to develop evaluation frameworks measuring AI performance, dealer satisfaction scores, service retention rates, and business value for specific automotive use cases.
  
**Pre-Sales & Prototyping:** Participate in automotive discovery workshops, technical deep-dives, and rapid POC development—using AI tools to prototype Vehicle Console configurations, dealer portal experiences, and Agentforce automotive agents for prospective clients.
  
**Product Team Liaison:** Liaise with Salesforce Automotive Cloud product teams to channel client implementation feedback, influence roadmap decisions, and ensure implementations align with platform evolution.

**You're Our Person If...**
---------------------------

**Experience & Platform Depth**

* Degree or equivalent proven experience (extracurricular leadership, military, volunteer, work experience)
* **9–14 years** CRM/enterprise software; **6+ years** Salesforce platform; **3+ years** Automotive Cloud
* Expert Automotive Cloud data model: Vehicle Console, Dealer Management, Fleet Management modules
* Expert-level Salesforce platform suite: Sales, Service, Experience, Automotive Cloud, Agentforce architecture
* Scalable solution design for high-volume automotive scenarios with AI-assisted load modeling
* LDV limitations, design patterns, and data distribution risk analysis
* Multi-tier dealer hierarchy sharing: OWD, sharing rules, and permission sets for OEM/dealer data isolation
* Platform security capabilities: TLS, SSL, and data encryption for automotive commercial data
  

**Integration, AI & DevOps**

* Expert DMS integration: CDK, Reynolds & Reynolds, Tekion; telematics ingestion platforms; OEM proprietary back-end systems
* Middleware platforms: MuleSoft, Boomi, Azure Integration Services; ETL/ELT frameworks
* Auth patterns: SAML, SSO, OAuth 2.0 — secure configuration for OEM and dealership enterprise identity providers
* DevOps: environment management, Git, Copado/Gearset, multi-sandbox deployment pipelines and release management
* Practical fluency: accelerate delivery using AI tools, document architecture, maintain code quality
* Agentforce design: dealer assist agents, connected vehicle chatbots, predictive service recommendations, intelligent recall orchestration
* Collaboration with customers to develop AI performance and business value evaluation frameworks
  

**Certification Pathway & Continuous Learning**  
**Required certification**  
Salesforce Administrator
  
Platform App Builder
  
Platform Developer I
  
Agentforce Specialist
  
Integration Architect
  
Sharing & Visibility Designer
  
  
**Preferred certification :**  
System / Application Architect
  
CRM Analytics Consultant  
  
  
  
**Leadership Qualities & Core Values**  
To navigate high-stakes technical environments and successfully lead automotive enterprises through digital disruption, the Technical Architect must embody specific consulting behaviors that translate technical capability into executive alignment and customer trust.
  
**Core Leadership Pillars**

* **PASSION:** **Customer Success First :** Deep personal investment in transforming complex OEM and dealer implementations into tangible market wins and measurable outcomes for automotive clients and their networks.
* **BEGINNER'S MIND:** **Continuous Learning :** Approaches every engagement with humbleness and curiosity—dismantling assumptions to keep pace with rapid shifts in EV transitions, connected vehicle technology, and consumer expectations.
* **ADAPTABLE:** **Thrives in Uncertainty:** Remains poised, agile, and decisive navigating structural volatility, shifting regulatory landscapes, and market disruption as permanent constants in the automotive sector.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and *be your best* , and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can *do your best* . Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form .

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.

de39403d.title: Senior Project / Delivery Manager

de39403d.description:
**Job Description – Senior Project / Delivery Manager**

**Experience:**

8-10 years

**Type:**

Full-time

**Location:**

Bengaluru, with frequent GCC travel

**About ALP**

Angel Lane Partners (ALP) is a computational finance, data engineering and AI/ML firm with offices in Dubai, London, Bengaluru and Riyadh. We work with banks, financial institutions and government entities across the GCC.

**Role Overview**

You will run ALP's technology implementation engagements at banks and financial institutions, from contract signature through go-live and handover. Engagements include credit and risk platforms, data platforms, calculation and analytics engines, and AI applications, often deployed on the client's own infrastructure. You will manage teams of business analysts, data engineers, developers, quants and AI engineers, and work alongside the client's business, risk and IT teams and any third-party vendors. You will report to ALP partners. This is a hands-on technical role: you will read, review and improve the code your teams write, including core calculation engines, data pipelines and application components.

**Travel**

The role is based in Bengaluru, with frequent travel to client sites in the GCC, sometimes for several weeks at a time. A valid passport is required.

**Key Responsibilities**

*Delivery and governance*

·      Own delivery end to end: mobilisation, requirements, design, build, testing, deployment, hypercare and handover.

·      Set up engagement governance, including steering committee and working group cadence, status reporting, RAID and decision logs, and escalation paths.

·      Build and maintain the integrated plan across workstreams, covering milestones, dependencies, critical path and resourcing.

·      Track effort, cost and margin against budget.

·      Manage scope against the statement of work, assess change requests and their commercial impact, agree acceptance criteria and obtain milestone sign-offs.

·      Coordinate third-party and client-appointed vendors where the solution depends on them.

·      Run lessons-learned reviews and feed them into ALP's delivery methodology.

*Technical implementation*

·      Agree the deployment architecture with ALP architects and client IT, covering on-premise, private cloud or public cloud hosting, environments (DEV, SIT, UAT, PROD), network access and integration points.

·      Plan and track integration with core banking, loan origination, treasury, data warehouse and reporting systems through APIs, file feeds or database interfaces.

·      Take the solution through the bank's IT and security processes, including architecture review, information security assessment, penetration testing, vendor onboarding, change advisory boards and production release approval.

·      Manage data readiness and migration, covering source identification, data quality, reconciliation and parallel runs.

·      Plan test phases (SIT, UAT, performance, security) with entry and exit criteria, and run defect triage.

·      Plan cutover, go-live, rollback and hypercare, and coordinate releases across environments.

·      On AI engagements, plan infrastructure and deployment with the AI team, covering hosted LLM APIs versus open-weight models on client infrastructure, GPU sizing, data residency, evaluation and monitoring, and the bank's model risk and AI governance requirements.

*Code and technical quality*

·      Review code in Python, SQL or C++ for correctness, performance, security and maintainability.

·      Check that code implements the agreed methodology, including risk calculations, business rules and data transformations.

·      Improve core components directly where needed, by refactoring, tuning performance and fixing defects.

·      Set and enforce coding standards, branching and pull-request practices, test coverage and code documentation.

·      Review cloud deployments on AWS and Azure, covering infrastructure configuration, access controls, scalability and cost.

*Banking and risk*

·      Translate business and regulatory requirements in credit, market, liquidity and operational risk into delivery scope and acceptance criteria.

·      Work with client risk, finance, compliance and model validation functions, and plan for review by internal audit and regulators (CBUAE, QCB, SAMA).

·      Review functional and methodology deliverables for consistency with banking practice before they go to the client.

*Team and business development*

·      Lead delivery teams across ALP offices and client sites: assign work, review output and give feedback.

·      Support proposals with scope, approach, delivery plan, effort and staffing estimates, and delivery risks.

·      Identify follow-on work within current engagements.

**Required Skills**

·      8-10 years delivering technology projects in banking or financial services, including at least 3-4 years as project or delivery manager on implementations at banks.

·      At least 3-4 years as a hands-on software engineer before moving into delivery or project management.

·      At least two software implementations at banks delivered from contract to go-live, such as risk, credit, data or regulatory reporting platforms.

·      Experience managing engagements with several concurrent workstreams across vendor, client and third-party teams.

·      Able to read, review and write production code in Python and SQL.

·      Hands-on AWS or Azure experience: compute, storage, networking, IAM, managed databases and application deployment.

·      Git, pull-request reviews, CI/CD and automated testing.

·      Understanding of bank hosting constraints: on-premise and private cloud, information security, data residency and outsourcing rules.

·      Current understanding of AI infrastructure and delivery: LLM APIs versus self-hosted models, RAG and vector databases, GPU requirements, evaluation, monitoring and AI governance.

·      Banking and risk knowledge: the credit lifecycle, PD/LGD/EAD and IFRS 9, market and liquidity risk fundamentals, Basel capital and regulatory reporting.

·      Experience with bank IT governance, including security reviews, vendor onboarding, change management and production approvals.

·      Commercial management covering budgets, effort tracking, statements of work and change requests.

·      Reporting to steering committees and senior client executives.

**Preferred Skills**

·      C++, particularly for pricing, risk or other calculation libraries.

·      Docker and Kubernetes.

·      Infrastructure as code (Terraform, CloudFormation or ARM/Bicep).

·      PMP, PRINCE2, SAFe or Agile certification.

·      FRM, CFA or an equivalent risk qualification.

·      GCC banking experience and familiarity with CBUAE, QCB or SAMA requirements, including outsourcing and data localisation rules.

·      Experience at a consulting firm, risk software vendor or systems integrator.

·      Delivery of AI/ML or LLM applications in a regulated environment.

·      Hands-on experience with commercial risk, credit or treasury platforms.

**Qualifications**

·      Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, finance or a related field; master's or MBA preferred.

·      Clear written and spoken English for executive audiences.
