**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
The Amazon Data Services (India) Pvt. Ltd. (ADSIPL) Data Center Security Group is seeking a highly talented and motivated Security Systems Project Manager to join our team. The team is responsible for the design, installation and integration of security systems equipment including, but not limited to, Access Control/Intrusion Detection and CCTV Surveillance systems.
  
  
You will also be responsible for the continuous review of existing standards and to stay abreast of developments in new technology that will enhance the physical security of ADSIPL data centers and co-locations. You will work directly with the Cluster Security Manager, the Infrastructure Operations and Construction teams, and other customers, both internal and external, to integrate the business' requirements into physical security systems design and implementation. Your work will include supporting the construction and deployment of physical security packages for all ADSIPL data centers and co-locations in the cluster. You will also work closely with contractors and vendors to ensure compliance with all security standards during the construction, testing and acceptance phases of the projects.
  
  
The ideal candidate for the role will have demonstrated the ability to work in all disciplines, at all levels; from technology research to system design and layout, oversight of construction and implementation, as well as maintenance and upgrades over the life of the system. You will have an in-depth knowledge of security technology, be innovative, highly organized, and will have demonstrated the ability to deliver results on time and within budget.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
You will be responsible for observing Physical Security Standards and Programs that support the goals of the Global Physical Security Team, while enabling the local site managers to draw related services from the team, in a self-service manner.
  
  
**This Includes**
Excellent large-scale project and program management experience, with the ability to work in a fast-paced environment
  
  
Lead physical security design and system installation for new data centers, data center expansions and special projects
  
  
Lead physical multi-million-dollar security project lifecycle management including bid packages, specifications, drawings, code compliance, vendor management, budget, change orders, and close-out documentation.
  
  
Contemporary knowledge of emerging physical security technologies to assess their applicability within the AWS physical security program.
  
  
Provide Subject Matter Expert (SME) support for leadership to make strategic decisions regarding technology and procedure.
  
  
Effective prioritization of tasks, and seamless operation across organizational boundaries
  
  
Execution and coordination of preventative maintenance and repairs to security system equipment.
  
  
Ensuring compliance with physical security project standards, project Scopes of Work, budgets and timelines.
  
  
Designing, developing, and implementing solutions for system installations, upgrades, repairs and change management.
  
  
Supporting security system equipment commissioning, Completing final Test, Acceptance and project hand-off
  
  
Building and deploying training programs for all users of physical security systems
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Mission: Deliver physical security infrastructure by working vigorously and collaborating with various stakeholders to earn and keep customer trust; providing a safe and secure environment for our people, assets, and customer data.
  
  
Vision: Develop exceptional security infrastructure delivery professionals, consistently apply security processes, and pioneer new technologies that effectively balance security requirements with operational needs.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of leading large complex programs experience
* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering/Communications Engineering
* Experience with security equipment such as intrusion detection devices, access control systems, etc.
* Experience with AutoCAD, Revit, Bluebeam, and MS Office Suite
* 10 years’ experience managing the Physical Security System Deployment Projects.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of vendor management experience
* 5+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* PMP, Prince2, PgMP, SAFe or SCRUM/Agile certification

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**Location** - Delhi, (Delhi NCR) **Experience** - 5-15 Years

###### **Vacancies - 1**

**WE ARE HIRING | DELHI NCR\***

**Senior Manager / Consultant – Technology Solutions & Digital Transformation**

**About the Role**

**Luminous Infoways is looking for a dynamic, technology-oriented professional who can engage with Government Departments, PSUs and Enterprise customers, understand their business challenges and present innovative IT and AI-driven solutions.**

**We are looking for someone who thinks like a consultant, understands technology, communicates like a business professional and has the aptitude to drive business opportunities.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Engage with senior customer stakeholders and understand their business and technology requirements.**
* **Conceptualise and present IT, AI/ML, Generative AI, Data Analytics and Digital Transformation solutions.**
* **Prepare solution concepts, proposals, presentations and technical demonstrations.**
* **Conduct customer meetings, solution walkthroughs and product demonstrations independently.**
* **Work closely with technical teams to translate customer requirements into implementable solutions.**
* **Identify business opportunities and support presales and business development activities.**
* **Understand Government/PSU procurement processes, tenders, RFPs and technical bid requirements.**

**Desired Profile**

* **5–15 years of experience in IT consulting, technology presales, solution consulting or business analysis.**
* **Good understanding of emerging technologies including AI/ML, GenAI, Cloud, Analytics and Enterprise Applications.**
* **Excellent communication, presentation, analytical and customer engagement skills.**
* **Ability to interact confidently with senior Government and Corporate stakeholders.**
* **Exposure to Government/PSU projects and tendering processes will be an added advantage.**

**Education: B.Tech / MCA / MBA (IT) or equivalent.**

**Who Should Apply?**

**Professionals who can combine business understanding, technology knowledge, consulting skills and commercial aptitude to help customers adopt the right technology solutions.**

**Interested candidates may share their CV at: career@lipl.in**

**Join Luminous Infoways and be part of our Digital Transformation & AI journey.**

3e8f740c.title: Senior Solutions Architect - Generative AI
3e8f740c.description:
NVIDIA is seeking a dynamic and experienced Generative AI Solution Architect with specialized expertise in training Large Language Models (LLMs) and implementing workflows based on Pretraining, Finetuning LLMs & Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). As a key member of our AI Solutions team, you will play a pivotal role in architecting and delivering cutting-edge solutions that leverage the power of NVIDIA's generative AI technologies. This position requires a deep understanding of language models, particularly open source LLMs, and a strong proficiency in designing and implementing RAG-based workflows.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Architect end-to-end generative AI solutions with a focus on LLMs training , deployment and RAG workflows.
* Collaborate closely with customers to understand their language-related business challenges and design tailored solutions.
* Collaborate with sales and business development teams to support pre-sales activities, including technical presentations and demonstrations of LLM and RAG capabilities.
* Work closely with NVIDIA engineering teams to provide feedback and contribute to the evolution of generative AI software.
* Engage directly with customers/partners to understand their requirements and challenges.
* Lead workshops and design sessions to define and refine generative AI solutions focused on LLMs and RAG workflows and lead the training and optimization of Large Language Models using NVIDIA’s hardware and software platforms.
* Implement strategies for efficient and effective training of LLMs to achieve optimal performance.
* Design and implement RAG-based workflows to enhance content generation and information retrieval.
* Work closely with customers to integrate RAG workflows into their applications and systems and stay abreast of the latest developments in language models and generative AI technologies.
* Provide technical leadership and guidance on best practices for training LLMs and implementing RAG-based solutions.

**What We Need To See**

* Master's or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, or equivalent experience
* 7+ years of hands-on experience in a technical AI role, specifically focusing on generative AI, with a strong emphasis on training Large Language Models (LLMs).
* Proven track record of successfully deploying and optimizing LLM models for inference in production environments.
* In-depth understanding of state-of-the-art language models, including but not limited to GPT-3, BERT, or similar architectures.
* Expertise in training and fine-tuning LLMs using popular frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Hugging Face Transformers.
* Proficiency in model deployment and optimization techniques for efficient inference on various hardware platforms, with a focus on GPUs.
* Strong knowledge of GPU cluster architecture and the ability to leverage parallel processing for accelerated model training and inference.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Experience leading workshops, training sessions, and presenting technical solutions to diverse audiences.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Experience in deploying LLM models in cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and on-premises infrastructure.
* Proven ability to optimize LLM models for inference speed, memory efficiency, and resource utilization.
* Familiarity with containerization technologies (e.g., Docker) and orchestration tools (e.g., Kubernetes) for scalable and efficient model deployment.
* Deep understanding of GPU cluster architecture, parallel computing, and distributed computing concepts.
* Hands-on experience with NVIDIA GPU technologies, and GPU cluster management and ability to design and implement scalable and efficient workflows for LLM training and inference on GPU clusters

With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, we are widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our exclusive engineering teams are rapidly growing. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with a real passion for technology, we want to hear from you!
  
  
NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

bf06bf1f.title: Delivery Manager - Engineering
bf06bf1f.description:
**Additional Information**

What Makes You a Standout Candidate

* Thinks like an Engineering Leader and Technology Strategist, not a traditional project manager.
* Uses AI, automation, and engineering insights to accelerate delivery and improve outcomes.
* Drives measurable improvements in efficiency, quality, reliability, and business value.
* Makes data-driven decisions using engineering metrics, delivery benchmarks, and business outcomes.
* Balances technology strategy, engineering excellence, people leadership, and business priorities.
* Builds a culture of innovation, continuous learning, accountability, and operational excellence.
* Successfully translates technology investments into measurable customer and business impact.

**Responsibilities**

About the Role

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Consultant - Delivery Engineering Manager to lead our engineering teams within the Benefits & Protection - Business Owner Solutions IT Platform organization. This is an outstanding opportunity to advance engineering excellence, technology modernization, and pivotal initiatives across business-critical platforms.

Responsibilities

Delivery & Execution Leadership

* Lead multiple cross-functional engineering teams delivering business-critical technology solutions.
* Drive the implementation of central initiatives, product roadmaps, modernization programs, and operational excellence objectives.
* Establish delivery governance, planning, prioritization, dependency management, release management, and risk mitigation practices.
* Ensure predictable delivery outcomes aligned with business commitments and organizational goals.
* Handle production support, operational health, service reliability, and continuous improvement initiatives.

Engineering & Technology Leadership

* Provide engineering leadership and technology oversight for assigned product and platform teams.
* Partner with architects and engineering leads to define and complete technology strategy and modernization initiatives.
* Drive engineering excellence through established guidelines, automation, quality engineering, DevOps, security, and operational resiliency.
* Support technical decision-making, architectural alignment, technical debt reduction, and platform simplification efforts.
* Encourage an environment that values creativity, ongoing education, excellence, and responsibility.

AI & Innovation Leadership

* Lead the adoption of AI-enabled engineering practices to boost development efficiency, delivery velocity, quality, and operational performance.
* Partner with engineering teams to identify, prioritize, and implement solutions powered by artificial intelligence that build measurable business impact.
* Promote responsible use of AI technologies, ensuring compliance, security, governance, and risk management standards.
* Drive innovation culture through experimentation, proof-of-concepts, hackathons, and emerging technology adoption.

Engineering Efficiency, Metrics & Outcomes

* Establish and drive engineering efficiency and operational excellence metrics across teams.
* Apply Developer Experience (DX) and Engineering Excellence frameworks to increase developer efficiency, system reliability, quality, and delivery predictability.
* Leverage engineering insights and platform metrics to identify bottlenecks, improve value stream flow, and increase team efficiency.
* Drive adoption of data-driven decision making using engineering, delivery, quality, and operational benchmarks.
* Promote automation-first approaches to reduce manual effort, improve scalability, and accelerate time-to-market.

People Leadership

* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop engineering talent across multiple teams.
* Drive employee engagement, retention, succession planning, and leadership development initiatives.
* Build high-performing, inclusive teams passionate about collaboration, innovation, and customer outcomes.
* Assist with recruitment, onboarding, workforce planning, and talent acquisition efforts.

Performance & Talent Management

* Own performance management processes including goal setting, development planning, talent assessments, and appraisal cycles.
* Conduct regular mentoring and career development discussions with team members.
* Identify growth opportunities and build development plans aligned with organizational needs.
* Recognize and reward performance while encouraging a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

Collaborator & Business Partnership

* Partner with Product Managers, Architects, Business Leaders, Operations, and Enterprise collaborators.
* Provide regular updates on delivery status, risks, dependencies, and strategic priorities.
* Influence decisions through data-driven insights, technical expertise, and strong business sense.
* Align engineering projects with business goals and customer results.

**Qualifications**

Education & Experience

* Bachelor's or higher degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 10-14 years of technology industry experience with progressive responsibilities in software engineering, technology delivery, or engineering management.
* 3+ years of people leadership experience leading engineering teams.
* Experience leading multiple Agile delivery teams in a complex enterprise environment.
* Proven experience managing performance reviews, talent development, goal setting, and employee mentoring.

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience leading geographically distributed teams across multiple locations.
* Experience assisting with location strategy, workforce planning, and organizational growth initiatives.
* Experience presenting to senior leadership teams and portfolio governance forums.
* Experience managing large-scale transformation or organizational change programs.
* Solid grasp of Agile, Lean, DevOps, Platform Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and Developer Experience (DX) principles.

953b2ad3.title: AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
953b2ad3.description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
* Experience leading technical delivery strategies, debugging systems, and interfacing with product/engineering organizations.
* Experience reading or debugging code in a general purpose coding language (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript, etc.).
* Experience with enterprise integrations (e.g., APIs, enterprise content management (ECMs), identity), cloud infrastructure, or AI/ML model deployments.
* Experience in system design or orchestration frameworks.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience orchestrating specialized technical resources to execute complex builds.
* Experience engaging with, presenting to, and influencing technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Ability to dive deep into novel technical problems, decipher extreme ambiguity, diagnose bugs, and emerge with credible architectural solutions.
* Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating deep technical integration issues into business impact.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud team helps companies, schools, and government seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way. You listen to the customer and swiftly problem-solve technical issues to show how our products can make businesses more productive, collaborative, and innovative. You work closely with a cross-functional team of web developers and systems administrators, not to mention a variety of both regional and international customers. Your relationships with customers are crucial in helping Google grow its Cloud business and helping companies around the world innovate.
  
  
As an AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), you will be responsible as an enterprise architect, technical debugger, and engineering liaison. You will bridge the gap between pre-sales agreement shaping and post-sales execution. Entering the agreement cycle during the technical evaluation phase for strategic accounts, you will ensure that solutions are shaped strictly through the lens of adoption, rapid activation, and viable delivery. You will be the overarching Enterprise Architect and Technical Delivery Manager charting the course. You will also be responsible for technical design, systemic debugging, product and engineering integration, and strategic FDE alignment. You will architect how these technical marvels actually integrate into the customer's IT ecosystem (connectors, identity, data residency, legal constraints) and drive the technical delivery strategy from start to finish.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with Account teams and practice Customer Engineer (CEs) during technical evaluation phases to assess project feasibility, shape proposals for long-term adoption, and validate FDE engagement requests.
* Lead upfront technical design for enterprise-grade AI solutions, ensuring seamless and secure integration of models, agents, and connectors into existing customer data pipelines, identity providers, and compliance boundaries.
* Dive into code-level context to diagnose and resolve complex customer implementation issues, identify core product bugs, and test workarounds to clear execution roadblocks.
* Serve as the definitive liaison to core Product and Engineering teams, troubleshooting systemic deployment blockers and translating real-world field feedback into actionable feature requests.
* Steer implementation strategy through technical authority and architectural foresight while owning the technical reality of delivery alongside customer-facing teams.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

dc85629f.title: Partner Solutions Engineer-Product & Platform Engineering
dc85629f.description:
Genpact runs customer operations at enormous scale—tens of millions of voice, chat, email and ticket interactions a year—in regulated, audit-intensive industries including banking, insurance and healthcare. Agentic CX is Genpact's point of view on where customer operations are heading: autonomous agents that don't just assist a human, but reason through a customer situation, decide the outcome and execute it end-to-end, escalating only the exceptions a human genuinely needs to see.

Genpact does not build the underlying conversational AI runtime. We partner with leading CCaaS and agentic platforms—Amazon Connect, Sierra, Observe.AI, NiCE and others—and own the layer that makes their platforms enterprise-ready: decades of process intelligence, exception logic and governance, encoded into four IP assets—CX Intelligence (powered by Maestro Spine), CX Assure, CX Insights and CX Integrate. Platform from partners; outcome ownership from Genpact.

Inviting applications for the role of
**Partner Solutions Engineer-Product & Platform Engineering!**

We're hiring a Partner Solutions Engineer into the Product and Platform Engineering organization behind Agentic CX. Where a Forward Deployed Engineer owns a client engagement end-to-end, the Partner Solutions Engineer is our depth specialist on the partner platforms themselves: you are the person who knows Amazon Connect, Sierra and Observe.AI (and the next platform we add) well enough to configure a production-grade voice or chat agent on any of them, and to make Genpact's domain intelligence portable across all of them.

You take a Genpact Standard Operating Procedure—written for a human agent—and convert it into an Agent Operating Procedure (AOP): a codified, testable set of decision rules, data lookups, disclosures, escalation triggers and tool calls that an AI agent can execute on a specific partner runtime. You then map every AOP back to the business requirement it serves—the outcome metric, the compliance control, the policy it encodes—so every autonomous decision stays traceable, auditable and explainable.

**Where You Sit**

You'll be part of the dedicated CX engineering capability inside Product and Platform Engineering, working alongside:

* Product engineering, who own CX Intelligence, CX Assure, CX Insights and CX Integrate as reusable, partner-agnostic assets that your AOPs are built on.
* Forward Deployed Engineers, who own the client relationship and go-live; you are their platform-depth partner on the harder configuration and integration problems.
* Domain operations teams, who hold the SOPs, exceptions and regulatory nuance your AOPs are translated from.
* Partner technical teams at Amazon Connect, Sierra, Observe.AI and others, whose platforms, roadmaps and best practices you track closely.

**What You'll Do**

* Convert Genpact SOPs into Agent Operating Procedures (AOPs): structured, testable agent logic, prompts, decision trees, tool calls and escalation rules, tailored to the target partner platform.
* Map every AOP back to the business requirement it serves—the outcome metric, policy or compliance control—so autonomy stays explainable and audit-ready.
* Configure and tune voice agents end-to-end on partner platforms, including:
* Amazon Connect: contact flows, IVR and routing logic, Lex bots, Lambda integrations, Contact Lens analytics and Agent Assist.
* Sierra: agent skills across the Agent Development Life Cycle (ADLC), prompt and eval design, and RAG-grounded knowledge configuration.
* Observe.AI: Voice and Chat AI agent configuration, prompt design, workflow and telephony setup, and AI Copilot tuning.
* Build and run golden test sets and evaluation frameworks so every AOP is validated before it ever touches a live customer interaction.
* Integrate partner platforms with CRM, ticketing and backend systems (e.g., Salesforce, ServiceNow, ticketing and core systems), using Maestro for selected backend integrations.
* Instrument agents with CX Assure and CX Insights so every interaction—human or AI—is scored, auditable and feeds the intelligence layer.
* Work with Forward Deployed Engineers to troubleshoot and harden configurations during embedded client engagements and go-lives.
* Maintain deep, current expertise on each partner platform's roadmap, new features and best practices, and feed platform-specific learnings back into reusable CX Intelligence, CX Assure, CX Insights and CX Integrate assets.
* Partner with governance, legal and compliance stakeholders to keep every autonomous decision within approved guardrails on every platform it runs on.

**What You'll Bring**

**Required**

* A software/solutions engineer, implementation engineer, or developer in a client-facing, platform-configuration-heavy role.
* Hands-on, production experience with at least two of: Amazon Connect (contact flows, Lex, Lambda, Contact Lens), Sierra (ADLC, agent/prompt tooling, eval frameworks), Observe.AI (voice/chat agent and workflow configuration, telephony integration).
* Strong software engineering fundamentals: comfortable writing production-quality code (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript or Go), working with REST/webhook APIs, and debugging in a live client environment.
* Demonstrated experience translating ambiguous business processes (SOPs, policy documents, exception logs) into structured, testable agent logic—i.e., converting SOPs into AOPs—and mapping that logic back to the original business requirement.
* Experience building or consuming golden test sets and evaluation frameworks for conversational AI or automation quality.
* Comfort configuring voice agent experiences specifically: IVR/contact flow design, telephony setup, prompt and dialogue design, IVR self-service.

**Preferred**

* Platform certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Amazon Connect Developer, or equivalent partner certifications from Sierra or Observe.AI.
* Experience in customer operations, contact center technology, or BPO/CX environments, especially in regulated industries such as banking, insurance or healthcare.
* Familiarity with RAG pipelines, LLM-based agent frameworks and prompt engineering beyond a single platform.
* Exposure to governance, risk and compliance concepts relevant to AI deployment (model cards, DPIAs, control-to-regulation mapping).
* Willingness to travel to client sites for embedded deployment engagements.

**How We'll Measure Success**

* AOP quality: SOPs converted into agent-ready logic that passes golden test sets on the first or second pass, with clear traceability back to the business requirement.
* Platform depth: ability to stand up a production-grade voice or chat agent on any of our partner platforms with minimal ramp-up.
* Outcome quality: resolution rate, containment, first-contact resolution and compliance defect rate against an agreed baseline, on whichever partner platform is in play.
* Reusability: platform-specific learnings and new exception patterns feed back into CX Intelligence, CX Assure, CX Insights and CX Integrate for the next engagement, on any partner stack.

**Why Join Now**

Agentic CX is a newly defined, fast-moving priority for Genpact, backed by a dedicated CX engineering capability being built through targeted hiring. As a Partner Solutions Engineer, you'll be the person who makes Genpact's domain intelligence work—production-grade—on whichever partner platform a client has chosen, shaping how we standardize AOP design across an expanding partner ecosystem.

d32dac25.title: Workday Solution Architect
d32dac25.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**

HRXP People Experience Lead

\_\_

**Your role and responsibilities:**

The Workday Solution Architect is a key expert within ABB's HR Experience Organization (HRXP), responsible for driving strategic value from ABB's Workday investment. This role bridges deep technical Workday knowledge with a passion for employee experience, ensuring ABB leverages the full potential of the Workday platform - including its growing AI capabilities.

This role is fully remote and open globally, offering flexibility in where the successful candidate is based. As part of our location strategy, cost-competitive locations are preferred, while the selection will ultimately reflect the right skills and experience for the role.

You will be mainly accountable for:

* Serve as ABB's Workday architecture lead, maintaining a holistic understanding of the entire Workday ecosystem, including HCM, Recruiting, Compensation, Talent, Payroll, Benefits, Reporting, Integrations, and emerging capabilities.
* Act as the internal authority on Workday configuration, ensuring solutions are scalable, sustainable, aligned with global standards, and optimized for ABB's business processes, security model, and organizational structure.
* Drive innovation and employee experience improvements by identifying opportunities to leverage Workday AI, automation, and intelligent recommendations to simplify employee and manager journeys.
* Partner closely with HR, IT, Enterprise Architecture, Integration teams, and business stakeholders to design, govern, and continuously improve Workday solutions and connected business processes.
* Own solution architecture and integration design, assessing the impact of changes across systems, processes, data flows, and stakeholder groups while ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
* Define, review, approve, and govern technical solution designs, architecture standards, roadmaps, and best practices, ensuring architecture, security, scalability, and sustainability requirements are met.
* Provide architectural leadership throughout delivery, implementation, and operational support, including major incident resolution, service stability improvements, and long-term remediation planning.
* Coach and guide Solution Architects and stakeholders on best practices, emerging Workday capabilities, and strategic technology decisions, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

**Qualifications for the role:**

  

* 5+ years of hands-on Workday configuration experience across multiple modules, with strong knowledge of business processes, security, integrations, and cross-functional dependencies.
* 7+ years of experience in Solution Architecture, designing and governing enterprise-scale technology solutions.
* Proven experience working within large, complex, global organizations and navigating diverse stakeholder environments.
* Strong understanding of Workday's evolving capabilities, including Workday Illuminate, AI-driven features, and HR technology innovations.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes and influence cross-functional teams.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, combining root-cause analysis with practical and sustainable solution design.
* Systems-thinking mindset with a natural curiosity to explore new capabilities, drive innovation, and identify opportunities to continuously improve the employee experience.
* Demonstrated ability to influence without authority, build consensus, lead architectural decision-making, and champion best practices across a global organization.

  

This opportunity is open to candidates in one or more countries covered by the European Pay Transparency Directive. The final work location will depend on the selected candidate. As pay may vary by location, compensation details will be shared with candidates who progress to the first interview stage.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit **https://www.abb.com** to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

,

d66050d8.description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Amazon has built a global reputation for being the most customer-centric company, a company that customers from all over the world recognize, value, and trust for both our products and services. Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun and Make History.”
  
  
As an increasing number of enterprises move their critical systems to the cloud, AWS India is in need of highly efficient technical consulting talent to help our largest and strategically important customers navigate the operational challenges and complexities of AWS Cloud. We are looking for Technical Consultants to support our customers creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Data Analytics, Application services, Networking, Server-less and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor for organizations ranging from start-ups to large enterprises.
  
  
As a Technical Account Manager, you will be the primary technical point of contact for one or more customers helping to plan, debug, and oversee ongoing operations of business-critical applications. You will get your hands dirty, troubleshooting application, network, database, and architectural challenges using a suite of internal AWS Cloud tools as well as your existing knowledge and toolkits. We are seeking individuals with strong backgrounds in I.T. Consulting and in any of these related areas such as Solution Designing, Application and System Development, Database Management, Big Data and Analytics, DevOps Consulting, and Media technologies. Knowledge of programming and scripting is beneficial to the role.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Every day will bring new and exciting challenges on the job while you:
  
  

* Learn and use Cloud technologies.
* Interact with leading technologists around the world.
* Work on critical, highly complex customer problems that may span multiple AWS Cloud services.
* Apply advanced troubleshooting techniques to provide unique solutions to our customers' individual needs.
* Work directly with AWS Cloud subject matter experts to help reproduce and resolve customer issues.
* Write tutorials, how-to videos, and other technical articles for the customer community.
* Leverage your extensive customer support experience and provide feedback to internal AISPL teams on how to improve our services.
* Drive projects that improve support-related processes and our customers’ technical support experience.
* Assist in Design/Architecture of AWS and Hybrid cloud solutions.
* Help Enterprises define IT and business processes that work well with cloud deployments.
* Be available outside of business hours to help coordinate the handling of urgent issues as needed.

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree
* 3+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree or above in computer science, engineering, analytics, mathematics, statistics, IT or equivalent, or Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* 7+ years of hands-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience
* Experience in external enterprise customer-facing role as a technical lead, with strong oral and written communication skills, presenting to both large and small audiences
* Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
* Be mobile and travel to client locations as needed.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer-facing environment as a technical lead

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

3e6ccef0.title: SaaS Security Delivery Lead
3e6ccef0.description:
**SaaS Security Delivery Lead**

*About the Job*

BluOcean Cyber is seeking a SaaS Security Delivery Lead to lead client engagements focused on SaaS security, security program maturity, and modern enterprise risk reduction. This role is ideal for a consulting-oriented security leader who can manage complex delivery work, build trusted client relationships, coordinate cross-functional teams, and ensure high-quality deliverables across multiple security initiatives.

You will serve as a client-facing delivery lead, trusted advisor, and engagement manager across SaaS security programs. You will help clients identify risk, prioritize remediation, improve security controls, and mature their security operating models across enterprise SaaS environments.

The ideal candidate brings strong cybersecurity knowledge, Big 4 or comparable consulting delivery experience, executive communication skills, and the ability to translate technical findings into clear, actionable deliverables. This is a leadership role for someone who can bring structure to ambiguous client needs, manage teams toward measurable outcomes, and ensure BluOcean delivers practical, high-impact work.

This role is well suited for someone who enjoys leading engagements from kickoff through final delivery, managing client expectations, coordinating resources, developing executive-ready materials, and helping scale repeatable consulting delivery capabilities in a fast-moving startup environment.

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead client engagements focused on SaaS security program development, risk reduction, control improvement, and implementation planning.
* Own end-to-end engagement delivery, including scope, timelines, workplans, stakeholder coordination, status reporting, risks, issue resolution, deliverable quality, and client outcomes.
* Manage day-to-day client engagement activities, including kickoff planning, recurring client meetings, executive updates, progress tracking, and expectation management.
* Partner with clients to understand business goals, security priorities, operational constraints, and risk tolerance, then translate those needs into practical delivery plans and prioritized recommendations.
* Develop polished, client-ready deliverables, including assessment reports, maturity models, security roadmaps, executive presentations, implementation plans, risk summaries, operating models, and business cases.
* Coordinate security engineers, consultants, architects, and client stakeholders to ensure work is completed on time, aligned to scope, and communicated clearly.
* Lead SaaS security program workstreams from discovery through recommendations and execution planning, including current-state assessment, gap analysis, roadmap development, and outcome measurement.
* Facilitate workshops and working sessions with CISOs, security leaders, IT teams, product teams, engineering teams, and business stakeholders.
* Translate complex technical findings into clear, business-aligned guidance for technical teams, executives, and non-technical audiences.
* Identify engagement risks, delivery blockers, scope changes, and client concerns early, and drive resolution in partnership with internal and client leadership.
* Support client relationship management by building trust, maintaining strong communication, and helping identify opportunities for additional value.
* Apply security frameworks and control models to help clients evaluate risk, prioritize improvements, and strengthen security governance across SaaS and cloud-connected environments.
* Partner with internal leadership to build repeatable delivery playbooks, templates, methodologies, client-facing collateral, and consulting offerings.
* Help BluOcean scale its consulting delivery model by bringing structure, rigor, accountability, and strong client-service practices into a high-growth startup environment.
* Mentor consultants and security team members on consulting delivery, client communication, deliverable development, executive presence, and engagement management.

**What You’ll Need — Required**

* 8–12 years of progressive cybersecurity, technology risk, security consulting, or security program delivery experience.
* Required experience working in a Big 4 or comparable consulting environment, such as Deloitte, EY, KPMG, PwC, Accenture, or another recognized cybersecurity, technology risk, or professional services consulting firm.
* Proven experience leading client-facing security engagements, including managing scope, timelines, deliverables, stakeholders, risks, and outcomes.
* Strong consulting delivery skills, including project planning, meeting facilitation, status reporting, issue management, executive communication, and client expectation management.
* Experience developing client-ready deliverables such as assessment reports, maturity models, risk summaries, roadmaps, implementation plans, executive presentations, and program recommendations.
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity concepts across SaaS security, cloud security, application security, identity and access management, security architecture, risk management, and security operations.
* Experience leading security programs, assessments, implementations, or transformation initiatives across complex enterprise environments.
* Ability to work with technical teams to understand findings, risks, and control gaps, then translate them into clear business and executive-level recommendations.
* Experience applying security frameworks and control models such as NIST CSF, NIST 800-53, ISO 27001, SOC 2, CIS Benchmarks, CSA CCM, or similar.
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to engage CISOs, security leaders, IT leaders, engineering teams, product teams, and business stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to lead teams, coordinate contributors, manage ambiguity, create structure, and drive work to completion.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to produce polished, client-ready materials.
* High ownership, accountability, and follow-through, with a strong focus on delivery quality and measurable client outcomes.
* Comfort operating in a startup environment where priorities evolve quickly, ownership is high, and leaders are expected to be hands-on when needed.

**What Sets You Apart — Preferred**

* Experience delivering SaaS security, SaaS risk, or SaaS Security Posture Management programs.
* Familiarity with enterprise SaaS platforms such as Microsoft 365, Salesforce, Google Workspace, ServiceNow, Workday, GitHub, or similar environments.
* Familiarity with SaaS Security Posture Management tools such as AppOmni, Falcon Shield, Obsidian Security, Reco, DoControl, Normalyze, or similar platforms.
* Experience leading engagements related to SaaS misconfiguration management, identity risk, excessive permissions, OAuth app review, third-party integration risk, or SaaS governance.
* Experience with cloud security, application security, product security, infrastructure-as-code security, CI/CD security, or security operations programs.
* Experience building consulting methodologies, delivery frameworks, templates, playbooks, technical enablement materials, or go-to-market security offerings.
* Experience building dashboards, metrics, executive reporting, control monitoring, or program governance materials.
* Ability to support business development activities, including scoping discussions, proposal inputs, solution shaping, and expansion opportunities.
* Relevant certifications such as CISSP, CCSP, CCSK, CISM, AWS Security Specialty, Azure Security Engineer, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, PMP, or similar.

**Why Join BluOcean Cyber**

BluOcean Cyber is building at the forefront of SaaS and modern security transformation. This is an opportunity to step into a client-facing leadership role where you will help shape how security programs are delivered, matured, and scaled.

You will work with ambitious clients, complex environments, and a team that values ownership, clarity, speed, technical depth, and practical impact. If you are ready to lead engagements, manage client relationships, build high-quality deliverables, and bring structure to a growing consulting organization, this role offers the opportunity to influence and deliver at meaningful scale.

If you are passionate about helping clients solve complex security challenges — and you are ready to lead delivery from strategy through execution — we want you on our team.

Apply now.

ee1d01d3.title: Lead I - Product Architect
ee1d01d3.description:
**Role description**

Data Architect Role Overview The Data Architect will define and own end-to-end data architecture for AI initiatives on Google Cloud Platform (GCP). This role establishes the data models, platform patterns, governance, and operational standards needed to support ingestion, storage, transformation, serving, and retrieval. Working with business stakeholders, AI specialists, platform engineers, and data engineers, the Data Architect will translate business needs into scalable data foundations and clear architectural direction. Key Responsibilities Data architecture and modeling: Own the architecture across BigQuery, AlloyDB/PostgreSQL, Cloud Storage, and related services. Lead conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling, including domain boundaries, partitioning, indexing, and schema evolution. Pipeline architecture: Establish reference architectures and reusable design patterns for batch and streaming pipelines using Dataflow, Cloud Composer/Airflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Run. AI-ready data foundations: Design data foundations for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), semantic search, and hybrid search, including document ingestion, chunking, metadata, embedding pipelines, vector storage using pgvector/ScaNN, and refresh and re-indexing patterns. Large language model integration and evaluation: Define standards for integrating large language model (LLM) APIs, including Vertex AI/Gemini and other providers, into extraction, classification, summarization, and enrichment workflows. Balance quality, cost, latency, and security. Partner with quality assurance (QA) to design evaluation frameworks covering golden datasets, sampling, human review, regression testing, and ongoing measurement of accuracy, consistency, cost, and latency. Governance and data quality: Establish validation, cataloging, and lineage architecture, including tools such as Dataplex. Define standards for personally identifiable information (PII), retention, access controls, and auditability. Reliability and operations: Set service-level agreement (SLA) and service-level objective (SLO) standards, monitoring, ing, idempotency, backfills, failure handling, and incident response. Lead architectural root cause analysis and post-incident reviews. Technology strategy: Evaluate data technologies and platforms, document trade-offs, and guide build-versus-buy decisions, cost optimization, and scalability planning. Support integration with hybrid-cloud and legacy systems, including Azure-based data services where applicable. Cross-functional architecture: Partner with the AI Architect and AI Engineer to support retrieval and agent solutions through sound data design. Work with the Platform Engineer on continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD), Infrastructure as Code, and environment standards for data workloads. Technical leadership: Mentor Data Engineers, conduct design and code reviews, and guide complex implementations. Translate business needs and data domains into architectural roadmaps, and produce clear architecture documentation and decision records for technical and non-technical audiences. Qualifications and Technical Expertise Experience designing end-to-end cloud data architectures, with expertise in GCP data services such as BigQuery, AlloyDB/PostgreSQL, and Cloud Storage. Strong conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling skills, including schema evolution, partitioning, indexing, and domain design. Experience defining batch and streaming pipeline patterns using Dataflow, Cloud Composer/Airflow, Pub/Sub, and Cloud Run. Experience designing data foundations for RAG, semantic and hybrid search, embedding pipelines, vector storage, and LLM-enabled workflows. Ability to define data quality, governance, lineage, security, retention, and access-control standards, alongside evaluation approaches for AI-enabled data use cases. Knowledge of data-platform reliability, monitoring, failure recovery, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code, with the ability to evaluate scalability, cost, and operational trade-offs. Ability to lead architectural decisions, mentor Data Engineers, collaborate across business and engineering teams, and communicate technical direction through clear documentation and roadmaps. Familiarity with hybrid-cloud and legacy-system integration, including Azure-based data services where applicable.

 **Skills**

AlloyDB, Google Cloud Platform, Data Modeling, Data Governance, LLMs, Vertex AI, Data Privacy, RAG, Observability, Google Cloud Dataflow, BigQuery

 **About UST**  
UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.

* Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate AI use cases, identify suitable technologies, assess technical feasibility, and define implementation roadmaps.
* Lead the architecture and solution design of enterprise AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.
* Translate business requirements, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into scalable and secure solution architecture designs, architecture diagrams, integration patterns, and technical specifications.

* Design enterprise integration patterns connecting AI solutions with APIs, databases, data platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise applications, event-driven systems, and external services.
* Evaluate and recommend appropriate foundation models, LLMs, embedding models, AI platforms, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and supporting technologies based on business, technical, security, cost, and performance requirements.
* Define architecture approaches for AI security, identity and access management, data privacy, guardrails, content filtering, responsible AI, model governance, and regulatory compliance.

The candidate must be keenly aware of organizational growth initiatives related to the life science market and target customer segments, as well as Certara’s potential to meet customer needs with our software products and services. **Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**

Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Join us to put AI to work for people.

* Experience in leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function or industry.

Chennai, India
  
  
**About The Team**
As a member of our Consulting Team, you understand our customers’ most pressing business performance challenges and you are committed to helping our customers solve complex challenges in the distributed value chain that is prevalent in manufacturing today.
  
  
****What you will do****

* Sound knowledge in Supply Chain concepts especially scheduling with 6+ years of experience.
* Strong intent to learn our first in class product “Maestro”
* Work in a fast-paced project environment and co-ordinate with members at all levels in an organization

* Ability to communicate complex ideas effectively in English, both verbally and in writing
* Technical skills such as SQL, R, Java Script, Python, etc.
* Experience with manufacturing planning solutions such as Kinaxis, SAP, JDA, etc. is an added advantage

#Senior
  
  
**Work With Impact:**
Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day—when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
  
  
**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:**
Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Ford, Unilever, Yamaha, P&G, Lockheed-Martin, and more.
  
  
**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:**
Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to net-zero operations strategy for the long term. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
  
  
People matter at Kinaxis and these are some of the perks and benefits we created for our team:
  
  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide day off on the last Friday of every month)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well-being programs

For more information, visit the Kinaxis web site at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .

1b903fea.description:
**About Us:**

Founded in 2002 in Sydney, with offices in India and a presence across the Americas and Europe, Prospecta is a leading data management software company. Our flagship platform, Master Data Online (MDO), enables accurate, compliant, and relevant master data for asset-intensive industries including Energy, Utilities, Oil & Gas, Mining, Infrastructure, and Manufacturing.

We pride ourselves on agility, collaboration, and innovation delivering real value to customers while fostering a diverse, growth-driven culture that encourages learning, embraces challenges, and celebrates success.

**About the Job:**

Senior Solution Consultant

**Location:**
Gurugram

**Role Summary:**
Prospecta is looking for an experienced Senior Consultant to join our Master Data Online (MDO) practice, supporting the design and delivery of enterprise data governance solutions on SAP. The successful candidate will bring a combination of SAP functional knowledge and strong consulting capabilities, including requirements discovery, stakeholder engagement, process design, workshop facilitation, and solution documentation. The role requires working closely with customers to understand business challenges and translate them into scalable data governance solutions.

**Must Have:**

* Experience working directly with customers in consulting and implementation roles is mandatory.
* 5+ years of experience in SAP consulting, or SAP master data governance, or part of SAP transformation initiatives.
* Strong consulting and business analysis skills, including requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, and customer engagement.
* Strong understanding of SAP business processes with functional knowledge in one or more domains such as Asset Management, Material Management, Business Partner, Vendor, or related areas.
* Excellent communication, presentation, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience with SAP Information Steward, SAP Data Quality Management, MDO, or other master data governance/data quality platforms.
* Been involved in integration projects where SAP was involved, understanding of SAP BTP and Integration Suite
* Familiarity with standards like ISO 14224 or other asset and equipment classification standards.
* Experience in data analytics, data quality management, or data transformation initiatives.
* Background in asset-intensive industries such as Oil & Gas, Mining, Utilities, Manufacturing, or similar sectors.
* Experience supporting pre-sales, solution consulting, and proposal responses.
* Experience working within consulting organizations or SAP practices of global system integrators.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Work as an integral part of the project team and help drive project outcomes as per the plan and scope.
* Lead customer discovery sessions, requirements gathering workshops, and solution design discussions to understand business needs and define solution approaches.
* Prepare and own the design document including all the test cases that will be used as acceptance of the solution.
* Understand the core MDO platform and ability to map the requirements into a solution design
* Act as a liaison between business stakeholders and technical teams throughout the project lifecycle, from design through go-live and stabilization.

* Independently run solution walkthroughs during build and other phases of the project
* Support pre-sales activities, including solution demonstrations and Statement of Work (SOW) preparation.
* Contribute customer and industry feedback to product enhancement discussions.

**Growth Path:**

At Prospecta, your career journey is one of growth and opportunity, whether you're looking to kickstart your career or accelerate your professional development in a dynamic, collaborative environment. You’ll have the opportunity to work on high-impact data governance and digital transformation projects for global clients, gaining hands-on exposure to leading master data management technologies, practices, and asset and master data solutions. As you demonstrate your capabilities and deliver results, you’ll have opportunities to advance into roles such as Project Manager or explore other cross-functional career paths. We’re committed to supporting your growth by providing the tools, guidance, experience, and opportunities you need to continuously strengthen your skills and take your career to the next level.

Benefits:

* Competitive salary;
* Comprehensive health insurance:
* Generous paid time off;
* Flexible hybrid working model
* Ongoing learning & career development;
* Onsite work opportunities; and
* Annual company events and workshops.

If you’re ready to join an innovative, forward-thinking organization and work alongside inspiring leaders like Julian Blackley, Romit Mukerji, Ritu Jakhar, Viji Madras and Mugdha Nayak we’d love to hear from you.

Join Prospecta and take the first step toward an exciting, impactful, and rewarding career!

**Job Summary**  

Were proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you're part of something bigger.

Our clients come from all walks of life and so do we. We are proud of our inclusive culture and encourage applications from the widest mix of talent, whatever your age, gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, gender identity, social background and more.

We are a disability-friendly company and would welcome a conversation with you if you feel you might benefit from any reasonable adjustments to perform to the best of your ability during the recruitment process and beyond.

  
  
**Job Details**  

**Job Type:** Permanent

**Title:** AI Solutions Engineer

**Department:** AMP Research SI

**Location:** Bengaluru or Gurgaon, India

**Reports To:** Principal Engineer

**Level:** 4

  
  
**About your team**  

Asset Management Platforms (AMP) is responsible for the design, engineering and delivery of technology solutions that support Fidelity's global Asset Management business. We partner with Research Analysts, Portfolio Managers, Asset Management Operations, Sustainability teams, and Distribution teams across Europe and Asia to deliver modern platforms that enhance investment research, knowledge discovery, data-driven insights, and informed investment decision-making.

Our team develops and supports the technology ecosystem used across multiple investment capabilities, including Equities, Fixed Income, Multi-Asset, Systematic Investing, and Sustainable Investing. Our platforms underpin critical research processes including company and market research, sustainability analysis, financial modelling, investment content management, knowledge discovery, collaboration, and research analytics, enabling investment professionals to generate high-quality investment insights and improve client outcomes.

As Artificial Intelligence continues to transform investment research and software engineering, we are investing in modern engineering practices that combine AI-assisted software development with AI-powered research capabilities to improve productivity, accelerate insight generation, and enhance engineering quality. The AI Solutions Engineer will play a key role in designing, developing, and delivering enterprise AI solutions while enabling engineering teams to adopt AI-enabled development practices safely, effectively, and responsibly across the Research Technology platform.

  
  
**About your role**  

The AI Solutions Engineer is a hands-on technical engineer responsible for accelerating software engineering delivery through the effective adoption of Artificial Intelligence and modern engineering practices.

Working closely with Engineering Leads, Solution Architects, Product Owners and software engineering teams, you will identify opportunities to improve engineering productivity through AI-assisted development while maintaining Fidelity's high standards for architecture, engineering governance, software quality and security.

You will combine strong software engineering expertise with practical knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI-powered development tooling to establish best practices for AI-assisted software engineering. This includes to make effective use of technologies such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI coding assistants to improve software design, implementation, testing, documentation and operational support.

The role is equally focused on engineering excellence and innovation. You will apply modern software and AI engineering practices through hands-on design, development, testing, deployment, and production support, contribute to architectural decisions within established standards, support the adoption and continuous improvement of CI/CD, DevSecOps practices and implement approved security, governance, and Responsible AI controls throughout the software development lifecycle.

This is an exciting opportunity to shape how AI is adopted across Asset Management Platforms, helping engineering teams deliver high-quality software faster while ensuring solutions remain secure, maintainable and aligned with Fidelity's engineering standards.

  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**AI Engineering Enablement**  

* Design, build, deploy, and support enterprise AI applications using LLMs, RAG, embeddings, vector search, tool calling, and agentic workflows.
* Build grounded RAG pipelines covering document ingestion, parsing, chunking, metadata enrichment, hybrid retrieval, reranking, citation, and response validation.
* Develop AI agents capable of planning, reasoning, maintaining context, invoking approved tools, and executing governed business workflows.
* Integrate commercial and open-source models through platforms such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, OpenAI, Anthropic, or equivalent services.
* Implement prompt and model configuration management, evaluation datasets, automated quality testing, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Evaluate AI technologies progmatically and select solutions based on business value, quality, security, latency, scalability, and cost.
* Coach and mentor engineering teams in the effective use of Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and other AI-assisted development tools.

  
  
**Software Engineering**  

* Build complete AI-assisted apps using modern frontend technologies such as Angular or React, TypeScript, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
* Develop secure and scalable APIs, microservices, and orchestration services using Python, FastAPI, Node.js, or NestJS.
* Integrate applications with enterprise APIs, market and research data, document repositories, collaboration platforms, and structured and unstructured data sources.
* Work with Relational, NoSQL, Cloud and vector technologies such as PostgreSQL, OpenSearch, Snowflake and pgvector.
* Participate in engineering practices, including modular design, API contracts, code reviews, performance optimization and secure coding.

  
  
**Engineering Excellence**  

* Champion modern engineering practices including Continuous Integration, Continuous Delivery and DevSecOps.
* Work with engineering teams to optimise software delivery pipelines.
* Promote unit test automation and engineering best practises throughout the SDLC.
* Create reusable AI services, reference implementations, engineering standards, and ready-to-use development capabilities that improve developer productivity.

  
  
**Architecture Governance**  

* Collaborate with Solution Architects and Engineering Leads to ensure solutions align with Fidelity's target architecture.
* Ensure AI-assisted software development complies with engineering standards, security policies and regulatory requirements.
* Promote sound software engineering principles including maintainability, scalability, resilience and observability.
* Implement controls for prompt injection, sensitive-data exposure, unsafe responses, hallucination, unauthorized tool use, and third-party model risk.
* Balance innovation with appropriate technology risk management and governance.
* Communicate technical decisions, risks, trade-offs, and delivery progress clearly to engineering, architecture, product, and business stakeholders.

  
  
**Stakeholder Engagement**  

* Build strong working relationships with Engineering Leads, Product Owners, Solution Architects and software engineering teams.
* Partner with investment technology stakeholders to understand engineering challenges and identify opportunities for AI-enabled improvement.
* Establish and support communities of practice around AI-assisted software engineering.
* Deliver demonstrations, technical workshops and knowledge-sharing sessions with senior investment professionals.
* Stay informed on emerging AI technologies and assess their applicability within Fidelity's engineering environment.
