**4. Financial & Commercial Management**

* Manage program budgets, revenue forecasts, profitability, and delivery margins.
* Monitor project financials, resource costs, billing milestones, and commercial commitments.
* Drive financial discipline and ensure adherence to contractual obligations.
* Identify risks to project profitability and implement corrective actions.
* Support proposals, RFP/RFI responses, effort estimation, commercial negotiations, and Statements of Work.
* Partner with sales and presales teams for strategic opportunities and account growth.

**5. Resource & Workforce Management**

* Manage resource allocation, capacity planning, utilization, and workforce forecasting.
* Ensure appropriate availability of QAD functional, technical, integration, and project management resources.
* Drive resource productivity, utilization, and effective deployment across programs.
* Identify skill gaps and develop capability-building and cross-training initiatives.
* Collaborate with competency leaders on hiring, talent development, succession planning, and resource retention.
* Build and maintain high-performing delivery teams across geographies.

**6. Risk, Quality & Governance**

* Establish program governance, quality assurance, and delivery control mechanisms.
* Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate program risks, issues, and dependencies.
* Ensure compliance with organizational delivery standards and customer contractual requirements.
* Drive defect management, testing governance, cutover planning, and go-live readiness.
* Implement lessons learned, continuous improvement, and delivery excellence practices.
* Maintain effective program reporting, dashboards, and executive-level communication.

**7. Leadership & Business Growth**

* Lead, mentor, and develop project managers, program leads, solution architects, and delivery teams.
* Drive a culture of accountability, collaboration, customer-centricity, and continuous improvement.
* Partner with Sales, Presales, Competency, HR, and Finance teams.
* Contribute to strategic planning, service line growth, and delivery capability expansion.
* Promote innovation through AI-enabled delivery, automation, and ERP modernization initiatives.

**Required Skills & Qualifications Mandatory Qualifications**

* 20+ years of experience in ERP implementation, consulting, and program delivery.
* 10+ years of experience in QAD ERP environments.
* Proven experience managing large-scale QAD ERP programs, including implementation, upgrade, and support engagements.
* Strong understanding of QAD ERP manufacturing, supply chain, distribution, and financial processes.
* Demonstrated experience managing multiple projects and geographically distributed teams.
* Strong program governance, financial management, risk management, and stakeholder management capabilities.
* Excellent customer-facing communication, leadership, and decision-making skills.
* Experience managing project budgets, resource utilization, revenue forecasts, and delivery margins.

**QAD Technical & Functional Knowledge**

* QAD Enterprise Edition (EE) and QAD Adaptive ERP.
* QAD MFG/PRO and legacy QAD ERP environments.
* Manufacturing, MRP, Procurement, Inventory, Sales & Distribution, Finance, and Supply Chain.
* QAD ERP upgrades, data migration, integrations, testing, and deployment.
* QAD technical landscape, including Progress 4GL, Qxtend, APIs, EDI, and integration technologies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Six Sigma, ITIL, or Agile certifications.
* Experience managing global ERP transformation programs.
* Experience in manufacturing industries such as Automotive, Industrial Manufacturing, Life Sciences, and Consumer Goods.
* Exposure to AI-enabled ERP transformation and delivery automation.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* On-time and within-budget program delivery.
* Customer satisfaction and customer referenceability.

* Resource utilization and workforce productivity.
* Reduction in delivery escalations and critical risks.
* Quality of deliverables and post-go-live defect reduction.
* Revenue growth and account expansion.

**Leadership Competencies**

* Executive communication and stakeholder influence.
* Effective decision-making and problem-solving.
* Financial and commercial awareness.

**Expected Outcome**
The QAD Delivery & Program Manager will ensure predictable, high-quality, and profitable delivery of QAD ERP programs while strengthening customer relationships, improving operational efficiency, developing delivery capabilities, and supporting sustainable business growth.

8510eeb4.title: Pre-Sales Techno-Commercial manager
8510eeb4.description:
**Position Summary:**

The Pre-Sales Techno-Commercial professional will support enterprise sales teams by designing, sizing, and proposing end-to-end IT infrastructure solutions. This role combines deep technical expertise (compute, storage, networking, virtualization, data center) with strong commercial understanding to drive successful deal closures and profitable growth.

**1. Solution Design & Architecture**

* Engage with customers to understand current IT infrastructure, workloads, and business needs.
* Design end-to-end infrastructure solutions covering:
* Servers & compute platforms
* Storage (SAN/NAS/HCI)
* Networking (LAN/WAN, SD-WAN)
* Virtualization & HCI
* Backup, DR, and data protection
* Create scalable, high-availability, and cost-optimized architectures.

**2. Techno-Commercial Proposal Management**

* Prepare detailed proposals including:
* Solution architecture diagrams
* Bill of Quantities (BoQ)
* Sizing and configuration
* Pricing and commercials

* Secure deal registrations, special pricing, and technical validations.
* Stay updated on OEM product roadmaps, certifications, and partner programs.

**5. Sizing, Performance & Cost Optimization**

* Perform workload sizing, capacity planning, and performance analysis.
* Recommend right-fit configurations (avoid over/under sizing).
* Optimize TCO/ROI for customers while protecting margins.

**6. Solution Positioning & Advisory**

* Position infrastructure solutions aligned to business outcomes (performance, uptime, scalability, security).
* Recommend modernization strategies (virtualization, HCI, hybrid cloud readiness).
* Act as a trusted advisor to enterprise customers.

**7. Internal Enablement**

* Train sales teams on infrastructure offerings and positioning.
* Develop reusable solution templates, proposals, and presentations.
* Support cross-SBU collaboration (cloud, security, software).

**8. Market Intelligence**

* Track trends in data center, HCI, hybrid cloud, and edge infrastructure.
* Analyze competitor solutions and pricing benchmarks.
* Identify new opportunities for solution bundling.

**Key Requirements**

**Experience**

* 4–8 years in pre-sales / solution engineering for IT infrastructure.
* Experience handling enterprise customers and complex solutioning.
* Exposure to RFPs and large deal cycles.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of:
* Servers (rack/blade), storage, and networking
* Virtualization platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, Nutanix)
* Backup & disaster recovery solutions
* Data center architecture & design
* Ability to perform sizing and create architecture diagrams.

**Commercial Skills**

* Strong understanding of pricing, margins, and deal structuring.
* Experience with BOM optimization and vendor pricing models.
* Ability to balance competitiveness with profitability.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent communication and presentation skills
* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability
* Customer-facing and consultative approach
* High attention to detail in proposals

**Key Competencies**

* Techno-commercial balance
* Solution-oriented thinking
* Ownership and responsiveness
* Collaboration across sales, OEMs, and delivery teams

**KPIs / Success Metrics**

* Win rate / conversion ratio
* Proposal turnaround time
* Accuracy of sizing and costing
* Revenue influenced / supported
* Gross margin on deals
* Sales team feedback / enablement effectiveness

**Reporting To**

* SBU Head – Infrastructure Solutions

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

* Strong technical depth in infrastructure + commercial awareness
* Experience in multi-vendor enterprise environments
* Ability to handle complex, high-value deals
* Proactive, structured, and execution-driven

Graduation in any stream

Good working knowledge in MS Office,especially excel) Zoho / CRM

c27d3724.title: Senior Solutions Architect
c27d3724.description:
We are looking for passionate technologists to join our Pre-Sales organization to ensure that our growth is grounded and guided by strong technical alignment with our platform and the needs of our customers.
  
  
MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects are responsible for guiding our customers and users to design and build reliable, scalable systems using our data platform. Our team is made up of seasoned technical sales professionals, software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success, including the design of their software, deployment, and operations. You'll work closely with our sales executives, helping customers solve business problems by leveraging our solutions, playing a key role in winning deals and driving the business forward. You'll be a trusted advisor to a wide range of users from startups to the world's largest enterprise IT organizations.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Mumbai for our hybrid working model.
  
  
As an ideal candidate, you will have
  
  

* Ideally 8 to 11 years of related experience in a customer facing role, with 5 to 7 years of experience in pre-sales with enterprise software
* Minimum of 3 years experience with modern scripting languages (e.g. Python, Node.js, SQL) and/or popular programming languages (e.g. C/C++, Java, C#) in a professional capacity
* Experience designing with scalable and highly available distributed systems in the cloud and on-prem
* Demonstrated ability to work with customers to review complex architecture of existing applications, providing guidance on how to improve by leveraging technology
* Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to convey complex technical and business concepts in a clear and compelling manner to technology and business leadership
* Ability to strategize with sales teams and provide recommendations on how to drive a multi-threaded account strategy, aligning other MongoDB and ecosystem resources to move towards a mutually beneficial account plan
* The ability to travel up to 25%
* A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

You may also have
  
  

* Experience selling databases and/or deploying applications with any of the major cloud providers
* Experience with database programming and data models
* Experience in data engineering or AI/ML projects
* Experience in transforming legacy systems and platforms into modern, scalable, and efficient technology stacks
* Understanding of popular sales methodologies/ frameworks such as MEDDPICC/ Command of the Message
* A MongoDB Certification
* A Cloud Provider Certification

What you do at MongoDB
  
  
In this role, you will work on complex opportunities where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of various factors. You will:
  
  

* Design and Architect: Design scalable and performant applications, systems and infrastructure for large software projects leveraging MongoDB
* Customer Advising and Value Articulation: Guide customers on architecture patterns and optimisation strategies for MongoDB, while clearly communicating its business value to the relevant stakeholders
* Sales Partnership: Collaborate with the sales team to drive account success through account planning, opportunity prioritization/qualification and pipeline generation strategy, while taking ownership of the technical aspects (including but not limited to technical discovery, demos, proof of value, presentations, sizing and documentation)
* Demand Generation: Proactively generate demand within the sales territory through self-driven technical initiatives, participation in events such as industry trade shows and account-based marketing events
* Customer Success: Foster strong customer relationships, build champions and ensure customer success and satisfaction
* Innovation and Improvement: Continuously seek opportunities to innovate and improve MongoDB solutions and processes (e.g. by relaying field feedback to the product team), as well as proactively mentor other Solutions Consulting team members
* Personal Training and Development: Engage in ongoing training and professional development to stay abreast of MongoDB product suite as well as industry trends

What you will learn
  
  
MongoDB Product Suite Mastery
  
  

* Core Database Server: Master the fundamentals and advanced features of MongoDB's core database
* Atlas and Advanced Services: Gain expertise in Atlas (fully managed cloud database service), Atlas Stream Processing, Atlas Data Lake, Atlas Full-Text Search, Atlas Vector Search, and Charts
* Relational Migrator: Learn to migrate from relational databases seamlessly

Market-Relevant Technologies
  
  

* Hyperscaler Ecosystem: Gain expertise in designing complex systems utilizing cloud services on hyperscaler platforms
* Complementary Technologies: Enhance your skills with partner and complementary technologies such as Apache Kafka and Kubernetes

Modern Architecture Design
  
  

* Design Patterns and Methodologies: Embrace best practices in microservices, DevOps, cloud, and security
* Cutting Edge RAG and AI Architectures: Help customers on their generative AI journeys and working with industry leading partners in the space

Sales Techniques and Soft Skills
  
  

* Effective Communication: Master presentations, demonstrations, and whiteboarding
* Client Interaction: Develop strategies for discovery and objection handling

Industry Insights
  
  

* Diverse Market Verticals: Gain exposure to a broad spectrum of interesting use cases across various industries

**Interested in a career that matters?**




At Novonesis, we believe biology holds the key to solving some of the world's biggest challenges. To unlock that potential, we are scaling AI capabilities that help our sales, marketing, and technical service teams work smarter, serve customers better, and create measurable business impact.

As an **Applied AI Solutions Engineer** , you will join the Strategy Deployment team within the Planetary Health Biosolutions (PHB) business division. Working at the intersection of applied AI, commercial problem-solving, and business transformation, you will help turn high-value opportunities into practical AI solutions that transform how commercial teams operate.

This is a forward-deployed engineering opportunity for someone who wants to combine strong technical expertise with visible business impact. You will move between commercial workflows, solution design, and hands-on development, owning the journey from identifying a business challenge to delivering solutions that users genuinely adopt and value.

**The Role & Your Impact**

In this role, you will design, build, deploy, and continuously improve AI solutions that enable PHB commercial teams to work more effectively and create measurable business outcomes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Solution Development**

* Work directly with PHB commercial teams to understand workflows, user needs, and business challenges, translating them into practical AI solutions.
* Design and build AI agents, applications, and workflows utilizing prompting, grounding, retrieval, tool usage, actions, and orchestration.
* Develop thin-slice solutions to rapidly validate user value and technical feasibility.
* Build iteratively with users, leveraging feedback and evidence to improve, redesign, or discontinue solutions where appropriate.

**Integration & Engineering**

* Securely connect AI solutions to enterprise platforms and data sources, including Salesforce, Microsoft 365, and approved AI services.
* Build integrations using APIs, connectors, and workflow technologies with appropriate identity, security, and approval controls.
* Work with structured and unstructured data, enterprise knowledge sources, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns.
* Design and develop solutions with security, privacy, responsible AI, maintainability, and reuse in mind.

**Evaluation, Deployment & Scale**

* Design and execute functional, integration, regression, and AI-specific evaluations covering groundedness, retrieval quality, agent behavior, reliability, and user experience.
* Test solutions with end users and make data-driven decisions on whether to scale, iterate, or stop initiatives.
* Deploy, monitor, support, and continuously improve production solutions in partnership with Central IT, ComEx, and other enterprise stakeholders.
* Document solutions, technical patterns, and key learnings to support ongoing maintenance, reuse, and scale across the organization.

**What You'll Need to Be Successful**

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* 2–6 years of relevant professional experience building and deploying AI, GenAI, or agent-based solutions in production environments.
* Hands-on experience with LLMs, AI agents, prompting, grounding, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool use, and orchestration frameworks.
* Strong programming skills in Python and/or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Experience working with APIs, data integration, Git/version control, testing practices, and CI/CD pipelines.
* Experience building workflows and integrations using technologies such as Microsoft Power Platform, Power Automate, Azure Logic Apps, Salesforce Flow, REST APIs, or similar tools.
* Experience taking AI solutions from prototype through deployment, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement.
* Good understanding of cloud platforms, identity and access management, secure enterprise data handling, responsible AI, and production reliability.
* Ability to work directly with business users and technical teams to translate business challenges into practical technology solutions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with enterprise AI platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Salesforce Agentforce, UiPath, or comparable technologies.
* Experience supporting sales, marketing, customer engagement, or commercial business functions.
* Curiosity and adaptability to work across different AI models, platforms, and frameworks while selecting the best technology for the business problem.
* Experience working in fast-paced environments with evolving priorities and emerging technologies.

What We Offer

At Novonesis, you will help shape how AI transforms commercial operations across a global, purpose-driven organization. You will work alongside experienced colleagues, gain exposure to cutting-edge AI technologies, and contribute to solutions that create tangible value for customers and the business.

We offer an environment that encourages innovation, learning, ownership, and professional growth while supporting our purpose of unlocking the power of biology to address global challenges.

**Application Deadline:** November 23rd November 2026 - *We review applications on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.*

**Our purpose guides the way**

In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.

**Opportunities for everyone**

We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.

We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.

**Explore other openings**

If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

**About The Job**
When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. * Own the technical relationship with partners, empowering them to drive a successful pilot or proof-of-concept, support partners in driving customer acceptance of the technical proposal, leading to an agreement, and work with partners during the migration phase to ensure they have all the tools necessary to deliver a successful deployment.

We are seeking an experiencedLead SuccessFactors AI Developer with strong hands-on expertise in building AI-powered applications, agents, and intelligent automations, ready to design, build and scale AI-driven solutions across our application landscape at Allianz Technology.
  
  
You will
  
  

* Design, build, and deploy AI-powered applications, agents, and intelligent automations that solve real business problems across multiple domains.
* Apply Model Context Protocol (MCP) and related standards to connect large language models and AI agents securely to enterprise systems and data sources.
* Use n8n (or similar workflow automation tooling) to orchestrate AI-driven workflows, combining LLM reasoning with deterministic business logic.
* Identify and lead AI-enablement opportunities across platforms such as SAP SuccessFactors, ServiceNow, and Global Identity and Access Management (GIAM), working with the respective platform teams.
* Own end-to-end delivery of AI initiatives — from prototyping and experimentation through to production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Define technical approach and architecture for AI initiatives, evaluating build-vs-buy options, model choice, and integration patterns.
* Ensure AI solutions are secure, explainable, and compliant, partnering with Security, Enterprise Architecture, and Compliance teams on responsible-AI practices.
* Mentor and guide junior developers on AI engineering practices, prompt design, and workflow orchestration.
* Act as a technical point of contact for AI-related initiatives, engaging stakeholders across business and IT to translate needs into practical AI solutions.
* Stay current with the fast-moving AI ecosystem (models, frameworks, agent protocols) and champion responsible adoption across the organization.

Your skills
  
  

* Strong hands-on experience building AI-powered applications, automations, or agents, with around 9–12 years of overall software/solution development experience.
* Practical understanding of Model Context Protocol (MCP) and how to expose enterprise tools and data safely to AI agents and LLM-based assistants.
* Hands-on experience with n8n or similar workflow automation/orchestration platforms, used to combine AI reasoning with business processes.
* Exposure to SAP SuccessFactors, with an understanding of core HR processes and how AI can enhance them (e.g. intelligent search, recommendations, automation of routine HR tasks).
* Working knowledge of ServiceNow, including its workflow/automation capabilities and how AI can be layered onto ITSM/ITOM processes.
* Familiarity with Global Identity and Access Management (GIAM) concepts, with practical exposure to applying AI (e.g. anomaly detection, intelligent access recommendations) within IAM processes.
* Solid understanding of API integration, authentication/authorization (OAuth2, SSO), and secure design practices for AI solutions.
* Demonstrated ability to define technical strategy for AI initiatives, evaluate tools and models, and lead solution architecture discussions.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, comfortable engaging senior technical and business audiences on AI opportunities and risk.
* Proven track record delivering software/automation projects across the full lifecycle, including mentoring junior team members.

Allianz Group is one of the most trusted insurance and asset management companies in the world. Caring for our employees, their ambitions, dreams and challenges, is what makes us a unique employer. Together we can build an environment where everyone feels empowered and has the confidence to explore, to grow and to shape a better future for our customers and the world around us.

0f85a90b.description:
* Job ID: 911747
* 12 - 16 Years
* 1 Opening
* Bengaluru, Kolkata

  

### **Role description**

### **Role Summary**

We are looking for an experienced **Oracle EPM Senior Solution Architect** to lead the architecture, design, and delivery of enterprise-scale Oracle EPM solutions. The role requires strong functional and technical expertise across the Oracle EPM Cloud suite, combined with the ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable and maintainable solutions.

The ideal candidate will be a **hands-on architect** who can provide technical leadership, guide project teams, conduct solution reviews, troubleshoot complex issues, and work directly with business and technology stakeholders throughout the implementation lifecycle.

### **Skills**

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead solution architecture and design for **Oracle EPM Cloud** implementations, enhancements, and transformation programs.
* Design scalable solutions across:
  + Planning / PBCS / EPBCS
  + FreeForm Planning
  + Financial Consolidation and Close (FCCS)
  + Account Reconciliation (ARCS)
  + Enterprise Data Management (EDMCS)
  + Profitability and Cost Management
  + Narrative Reporting
  + Essbase
* Lead requirements gathering and translate business requirements into functional and technical solution designs.
* Define application architecture including dimensions, metadata, forms, business rules, calculations, security, integrations, reporting, and workflow.
* Design complex **Essbase calculations, Calc Manager rules, Groovy rules, and performance optimization strategies**.
* Architect integrations between Oracle EPM and ERP, HCM, data warehouses, and other enterprise systems using appropriate Oracle integration technologies.
* Provide architecture guidance for data integration, metadata management, reconciliation, and automation.
* Perform solution and design reviews to ensure adherence to Oracle EPM best practices and enterprise architecture standards.
* Troubleshoot complex application, calculation, data integration, performance, and environment issues.
* Lead technical discussions with customers, business stakeholders, infrastructure teams, and Oracle Support when required.
* Provide technical leadership and mentorship to consultants, developers, and support teams.
* Support estimation, solution planning, project execution, risk identification, and technical decision-making.
* Participate in pre-sales activities, solution assessments, proposals, effort estimation, and customer presentations when required.
* Establish reusable standards, implementation methodologies, design patterns, and documentation for EPM delivery.
* Support production deployments, quarterly Oracle Cloud updates, regression testing, and application lifecycle management.

### **Required Skills & Experience**

* Strong experience implementing and supporting **Oracle EPM Cloud** solutions.
* Deep expertise in at least two or more major Oracle EPM modules, with broad understanding of the overall EPM platform.
* Strong knowledge of:
  + Oracle Planning / PBCS / EPBCS
  + Essbase / ASO / BSO
  + Calculation scripts and Calc Manager
  + Groovy business rules
  + Data Integration / Data Management
  + REST APIs and automation
  + Smart View and reporting
  + Security and application administration
* Strong understanding of multidimensional application design, metadata architecture, calculation optimization, and EPM performance tuning.
* Experience designing integrations between EPM and Oracle ERP Cloud or other financial systems.
* Strong understanding of financial planning, forecasting, budgeting, management reporting, and close processes.
* Ability to diagnose and resolve complex functional and technical issues.
* Experience leading architecture discussions and design workshops with senior stakeholders.
* Strong communication, presentation, documentation, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to lead multiple workstreams and provide technical oversight across project teams.

### **Leadership Expectations**

The Senior Solution Architect should be able to:

* Own the EPM solution from **architecture through successful deployment**.
* Challenge designs and recommend simpler, scalable alternatives.
* Provide hands-on support when teams encounter complex technical problems.
* Mentor senior consultants and technical leads.
* Communicate technical decisions clearly to both business leadership and technical teams.
* Balance immediate project requirements with long-term maintainability and application performance.

### **Suggested Experience Level**

**14+ years of overall EPM experience**, with significant hands-on Oracle EPM experience and demonstrated responsibility for solution architecture and technical leadership.

  

**About Grant Thornton INDUS**
------------------------------

Grant Thornton INDUS is the global capability center for Grant Thornton US, the U.S. member firm of Grant Thornton International Ltd., a leading global network of independent audit, tax, and advisory firms. Founded in Chicago in 1924, Grant Thornton US is one of the leading accounting and advisory firms in the U.S., bringing together $4B+ in revenue, 56 U.S. offices, and a multi-national platform spanning 20 countries with 25,000 people. It combines deep expertise, advanced technology, and a collaborative mindset to help clients solve complex challenges and grow with confidence. Since 2012, Grant Thornton INDUS has brought together 3,300+ professionals across Tax, Audit, Advisory, Client Services, Innovation, and Enabling Functions to deliver high-impact solutions for Grant Thornton US and its global network. Recognized as a Great Place To Work® for three consecutive years and among India’s Top 15 Best Workplaces™ in Professional Services 2026, INDUS offers a high-performance culture where people are trusted, supported, and empowered to grow.

70ef463d.title: Sr Solutions Architect, AWS Industries India - S&T
70ef463d.description:
**Description**
The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers in their cloud journeys and work backwards from their industry-specific needs to transform their businesses and industries. Our team focuses on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.
  
  
As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Solutions Architect within the Strategic Accounts segment you are responsible for partnering with our most valuable customers to design cloud architectures utilizing AWS services. You have technical depth, business aptitude, and the ability to lead in-depth technology discussions, articulating the business value of the AWS platform and services. Effective communication and interpersonal skills are required for engaging and influence Enterprise Architects, Technical Architects, Cloud Architects, Directors, VP’s and CXOs.
  
  
You will be part of a culture of innovation where you’ll use AWS services to help our customers solve business challenges such as rapidly releasing products/services to the market or building an elastic, scalable, cost optimized application. Enable innovation through continuous deployment in DevOps, build highly scalable web & mobile applications with data store technologies.
  
  
AWS services cover a wide range of technologies including operational security, infrastructure, DevOps, highly available software architectures, observability, machine learning and analytics. 29ea3ae9.description:
Are you passionate about designing AI systems that solve real customer challenges?

Do you enjoy working hands-on with customers to turn complex business problems into scalable, production-ready AI solutions?

Are you excited by the opportunity to shape agentic AI architectures that deliver measurable business impact?

At SoftwareOne, we help organizations unlock the value of AI, cloud, and data through practical, scalable, and outcome-focused solutions. We are looking for a Forward Deployed Architect - Agentic AI to lead the technical architecture behind production-grade AI systems deployed in real customer environments.

As a Forward Deployed Architect, you will work at the intersection of customer context, systems architecture, and applied AI. You will lead customer engagements from problem discovery through solution design, deployment, and iteration, ensuring AI solutions are technically robust, scalable, and aligned with business outcomes.

**Your key responsibilities:**

* Leading customer engagements from discovery through architecture design, deployment, and continuous improvement.
* Translating complex business challenges into practical agentic AI architectures, including multi-step workflows, tool use, and external system integrations.
* Designing production-grade AI systems, including data flows, system boundaries, monitoring, observability, and operational readiness.
* Defining architecture patterns and technical standards for integrating models, agents, and AI workflows into customer environments.
* Guiding prototypes into scalable, reliable, and maintainable production solutions while balancing speed, quality, and business value.
* Mentoring engineers and architects, sharing best practices, and raising delivery standards across AI projects.

**Job Requirements**

* Strong experience architecting and delivering AI, ML, or software systems in production environments.
* Hands-on technical expertise in Python or comparable programming languages such as Go, Rust, or similar.
* Practical knowledge of modern AI and ML frameworks such as PyTorch, Hugging Face, or equivalent technologies.
* Solid understanding of AI/ML lifecycles, including deployment, monitoring, iteration, and production reliability.
* Strong software architecture fundamentals across distributed systems, data modeling, integration patterns, and system design.
* Excellent customer-facing communication skills, with the ability to explain technical trade-offs and business value clearly.

**Company description**


SoftwareOne is a global provider of software and cloud solutions. With a presence in over 70 countries and more than 12,000 professionals, we help organizations optimize software investments, modernize applications, and unlock the value of cloud, data, and AI.
  
  

Our people are at the core of everything we do. We enable collaboration across borders, continuous learning, and opportunities to grow in a fast-evolving technology landscape. Whether your focus is on technology, customer success, or business operations, your ideas matter, and your contributions make a difference.
  
  

Join a global team where you can build your skills, work with leading technologies, and make a real impact for our customers.

ff0bf7f3.title: Cloud Security Architect
ff0bf7f3.description:
Role Purpose

Secure enterprise cloud environments on at least one platform: Azure, AWS or GCP. The candidate should combine cloud-security engineering or architecture with IAM/PAM, Zero Trust, governance, compliance and DevSecOps. Practical AI/ML or GenAI exposure is mandatory.

Key Responsibilities

* Design and implement security controls in Azure, AWS or GCP.
* Secure cloud identity, privileged access, networks, workloads, data, keys, secrets and logging.
* Implement IAM/PAM, least privilege, conditional access and Zero Trust patterns.
* Establish cloud governance, policies, guardrails and compliance evidence.
* Integrate cloud security into CI/CD and Infrastructure as Code workflows.
* Use CSPM, CNAPP, SIEM or native cloud-security services to detect and remediate risk.
* Apply AI/ML or GenAI for security posture summarization, alert triage, policy generation, threat detection, remediation guidance or control mapping.
* Evaluate AI output, restrict sensitive data exposure and maintain approval for high-impact security changes.

Mandatory Skills

* Strong Azure, AWS or GCP security
* IAM and PAM
* Zero Trust
* Cloud governance and compliance
* DevSecOps
* CSPM / CNAPP
* Cloud networking and workload security
* Infrastructure as Code security
* Logging, monitoring and incident integration

Artificial Intelligence / Generative AI / AI-ML

Preferred Tools and Platforms

* Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Entra ID, Sentinel, Azure Policy
* AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, IAM, CloudTrail, Config, KMS
* Google Security Command Center, Cloud IAM and logging services
* Wiz, Prisma Cloud, Orca or equivalent CNAPP/CSPM
* Terraform, Checkov, tfsec, CI/CD platforms
* CyberArk or cloud privileged-access controls
* Azure OpenAI, Bedrock, Vertex AI or ML services

8fcb03b7.title: Senior Manager  Solution Architect/Enterprise Architect
8fcb03b7.description:
**About Cognizant Corporate**

Cognizant Corporate is a global community united by a shared purpose:  to make a meaningful impact.  We are committed to excellence and driven by outcomes that matter.  Collaboration is at the heart of how we work, and our forward-thinking mindset fuels continuous learning, innovation, and growth.

At Cognizant, careers transcend titles.  We empower our people to think strategically, inspire others, and lead with purpose – always guided by our core values.  Join us in shaping future of business.

**About the Role**

As a **Senior Manager – Solution Architect / Enterprise Architect**, you will lead the design and governance of enterprise-scale, production-grade technology solutions that enable business transformation and innovation. You will be a key member of the Architecture and Engineering leadership team, collaborating with business stakeholders, product teams, engineering, security, infrastructure, and operations teams.

You will have the opportunity to shape technology strategy, define future-state architectures, and guide the delivery of scalable, secure, and resilient cloud solutions. This role requires balancing strategic thinking with hands-on architecture leadership while driving technology excellence across complex enterprise environments.

**In this Role, You Will:**

* Define end-to-end architecture for enterprise platforms, applications, integrations, and digital transformation initiatives.
* Design scalable, secure, high-availability, and production-grade cloud-native solutions.
* Establish architecture standards, governance frameworks, and reusable design patterns.
* Lead cloud transformation, modernization, migration, and deployment strategy initiatives.
* Drive architecture reviews, technology evaluations, and solution approval processes.
* Ensure solutions meet key non-functional requirements including security, performance, reliability, scalability, and compliance.
* Partner with engineering, security, data, infrastructure, and business teams to deliver strategic technology outcomes.
* Mentor architects and technical leaders while promoting architecture best practices across the organization.
* Embrace our vibrant culture by striving for excellence, focusing on meaningful outcomes, and collaborating effectively. Take ownership, build relationships, and focus on personal growth to drive business strategy and foster an inclusive culture, creating unmatched career opportunities and impactful work.

**What You Must Have to Be Considered**

1. 12+ years of experience in technology delivery with significant experience in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture, or Technology Leadership roles.
2. Proven experience designing and governing enterprise-scale, production-grade solutions.
3. Deep expertise in cloud platforms (Azure preferred), cloud-native architectures, and modern application design patterns.
4. Strong understanding of microservices, APIs, integration architectures, DevSecOps, CI/CD, and deployment strategies.
5. Experience defining and implementing non-functional requirements including security, scalability, availability, performance, and disaster recovery.
6. Strong stakeholder management, leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills.
7. A strong sense of ownership, desire to create meaningful outcomes, and passion for work that serves a greater good for customers, communities, or global challenges.
8. The embodiment of Cognizant’s Values of: Work as One, Dare to Innovate, Raise the Bar, Do The Right Thing, & Own It.

**These Will Help You Succeed**

1. Experience with AI/GenAI, Data & Analytics, and intelligent automation platforms.
2. Expertise in Kubernetes, container platforms, and Infrastructure as Code.
3. Experience leading large-scale cloud modernization and digital transformation programs.
4. Knowledge of enterprise architecture frameworks and governance practices.
5. Experience with multi-cloud, event-driven, and distributed system architectures.
6. Strong mentoring and technical leadership capabilities.
7. Ability to influence senior executives and drive strategic technology decisions.

**Work model –**

We believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3-4 days a week in a client or Cognizant office. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance though our various wellbeing programs.

The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.

We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

133a2dfe.title: TechOps-CloudOps-DevOps-Staff
133a2dfe.description:
Location: Kochi

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Nov 11, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1757946

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**The opportunity**

We are looking for a Staff CloudOps Engineer with 3–4 years of hands-on experience in AWS and Azure environments. The primary focus of this role is supporting DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines, automation scripting, and container orchestration. The role also involves contributing to basic cloud infrastructure management and support. You will assist in troubleshooting, support deployment pipelines, and participate in operations across cloud-native environments.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Assist in resolving infrastructure and DevOps-related incidents and service requests.
* Support CI/CD pipeline operations and automation workflows.
* Implement infrastructure as code using Terraform.
* Monitor platform health using native tools like AWS CloudWatch and Azure Monitor.
* Collaborate with CloudOps and DevOps teams to address deployment or configuration issues.
* Maintain and update runbooks, SOPs, and automation scripts as needed.
* You will be responsible for executing tasks with increasing autonomy, applying sound judgment within defined parameters, and contributing to team outcomes. You are expected to demonstrate initiative, resolve routine issues independently, and support junior colleagues.
* You will anticipate and identify risks within engagements and share any issues with senior members of the team.
* In line with EY commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of high quality and is reviewed by the next-level reviewer.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

* Working knowledge of AWS and Azure core services.
* Experience with Terraform; exposure to CloudFormation or ARM templates is a plus.
* Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes (EKS/AKS), and Helm.
* Basic scripting in Bash; knowledge of Python is a plus.
* Understanding of ITSM tools such as ServiceNow.
* Knowledge of IAM, security groups, VPC/VNet, and basic networking.
* Strong troubleshooting and documentation skills.

  

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* 3–4 years of experience in CloudOps, DevOps, or cloud infrastructure support.
* Hands-on experience in supporting cloud platforms like AWS and/or Azure.
* Familiarity with infrastructure automation, CI/CD pipelines, and container platforms.
* Relevant cloud certification (AWS/Azure) preferred.
* Willingness to work in a 24x7 rotational shift-based support environment.
* No location constraints

  

**Technologies and Tools**

**Must haves**

* Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure
* Infrastructure as Code: Terraform (hands-on)
* CI/CD: Basic experience with GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, or AWS CodePipeline
* Containerization: Exposure to Kubernetes (EKS/AKS), Docker
* Monitoring: AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor
* Scripting: Bash
* Incident Management: Familiarity with ServiceNow or similar ITSM tool

  

**Good to have**

* Templates: CloudFormation, ARM templates
* Scripting: Python
* Security: IAM Policies, RBAC
* Observability: Datadog, Splunk, OpenTelemetry
* Networking: VPC/VNet basics, load balancers
* Certification: AWS/Azure (Associate-level preferred)

  

**What we look for**

* **Enthusiastic learners with a passion for cloud technologies and DevOps practices.**
* **Problem solvers with a proactive approach to troubleshooting and optimization.**
* **Team players who can collaborate effectively in a remote or hybrid work environment.**
* **Detail-oriented professionals with strong documentation skills.**

  

**What we offer**

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

* **Continuous learning:** You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* **Success as defined by you:** We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* **Transformative leadership:** We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* **Diverse and inclusive culture:** You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

bd7bc12c.title: IN-Technical Consultant Int - Cloud
bd7bc12c.description:
Scope: The IN-Technical Consultant Int – Cloud acts as the point of escalation for infrastructure operations, responsible for handling complex issues, driving root cause analysis, and implementing long-term solutions. This role also contributes to infrastructure design, optimization, and strategic initiatives, while mentoring L1/L2 teams and ensuring adherence to best practices. Our current technical environment: • Microsoft Azure • VMware ESXi What you’ll do: • Perform troubleshooting of hardware, OS, and network issues based on standard operating procedures (SOPs). • Log, track, and update incidents and requests in the ticketing/ITSM system. • Escalate unresolved issues to L3 teams with proper documentation and logs. • Perform routine health checks, daily checklist activities, and report deviations. • Support user requests related to access, password resets, and basic infra queries. • Adhere to defined processes, SLAs, and compliance/security guidelines. • Maintain accurate documentation of incidents, knowledge articles, and runbooks. • Manage servers (Windows/Linux), virtualization platforms, storage systems, and network devices. • Implement standard changes and upgrades to infrastructure components. • Support patching, backup/restore operations, and performance monitoring. • Create technical documentation, knowledge articles, and mentor L1/L2 engineers. • Participate in audits, compliance checks, and ensure security standards are met. • Collaborate with architects and project teams on infrastructure design and integration. What we are looking for: • Bachelor’s degree in IT/Computer Science/Electronics (preferred) or equivalent diploma. • 5+ years of relevant infrastructure support/engineering experience • Relevant certifications (e.g., Microsoft, Red Hat, VMware, CCNA, ITIL Intermediate) are highly desirable. • Deep expertise in at least two infrastructure domains (e.g., server administration, networking, storage, cloud, security). • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with ability to solve complex, multi-domain issues. • Experience with automation/scripting (PowerShell, Python, Ansible, Terraform, etc.). • Hands-on experience with enterprise monitoring, backup, and ITSM tools. • Strong understanding of ITIL processes and enterprise operations. • Excellent communication and leadership skills to collaborate with business, operations, and engineering teams. • This role involves rotational shifts, including night shifts, to provide 24/7 application support. • Flexibility to work weekends and public holidays as per shift schedule. • Ability to handle responsibilities independently during off-hours.//Req\_20

**Our Values**

7263b93b.description:

The MS portfolio consists of complex, multi-disciplinary, large scale, multi-year datacenter construction and lease projects. In alignment with our Microsoft values, we are committed to cultivating an inclusive work environment for all employees to positively impact our culture every day.

The Datacenter Engineering Lease Program Manager will support the delivery and technical oversight of lease data centers and short-term AI Infrastructure-as-a-Service contracts across the APAC region. This role will focus on evaluating the technical readiness, compliance, and ongoing performance of third-party datacenter infrastructure supporting high-density AI/GPU deployments.

* The Technical Program Manager will serve as a primary engineering interface between Microsoft and external providers, coordinating across regional engineering, operations, construction, networking, and other technical stakeholders.
* The role will lead **technical feasibility assessments for prospective sites, engineering audits of existing facilities, and troubleshooting of infrastructure issues at operational sites**.

The Lease Program Manager must be able to evaluate mission-critical infrastructure serving high-density compute environments, identify technical risks and gaps, engage the appropriate engineering SMEs, and drive issues through resolution.

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Lead technical audits and compliance assessments of third-party datacenter facilities supporting cloud and AI infrastructure service contracts.

* Review provider design documentation and technical information against Microsoft requirements, with particular focus on electrical and mechanical infrastructure supporting high-density compute deployments.
* Provide technical support and coordinate troubleshooting for **existing operational sites**, partnering with providers, Microsoft Operations, and engineering SMEs to understand infrastructure issues and drive resolution.
* Coordinate external architects, engineers, consultants, and technical vendors performing site assessments, design reviews, audits, and engineering studies.

* Identify technical gaps, risks, dependencies, and decisions required to determine site feasibility and readiness.

* Maintain technical documentation, audit findings, risk registers, action items, and project information within applicable portfolio tools and document repositories.
* Develop and present regular portfolio-level reporting covering site readiness, audit findings, technical risks, outstanding issues, and required decisions.

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's Degree AND 6+ years of experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.
* 3+ years of experience managing cross-functional and/or cross-team projects

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 12+ years of experience in mission-critical or high-tech infrastructure such as datacenters, semiconductor facilities, large-scale manufacturing, pharmaceutical facilities, or oil and gas.
* 8+ years of experience managing complex, cross-functional engineering or infrastructure projects.
* Demonstrated electrical and/or mechanical engineering expertise in mission-critical infrastructure, including the ability to independently evaluate engineering designs, system capacity, redundancy, reliability, technical risks, and infrastructure limitations.
* Ability to perform mechanical reviews of cooling plant and distribution, liquid cooling/CDU integration, heat rejection, controls, and high-density rack-to-facility integration will be plus
* Experience working with technical vendors, engineering consultants, contractors, or infrastructure providers.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex engineering issues into clear risks, actions, and decisions.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Demonstrated ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical organizations and with both internal and external stakeholders.
* Review proposed solutions and technical studies, escalating complex discipline matters to SMEs as required.
* Experience assessing infrastructure supporting high-density AI or accelerated-compute environments.
* Experience working with third-party datacenter, colocation, hosting, or infrastructure service providers.
* Knowledge of commercial contracts, technical exhibits, provider obligations, and contractual remedies.
* Knowledge of the APAC datacenter and third-party infrastructure market

Your skills
  
  

* Around 12+ years of overall IT experience, including a minimum of 6+ years designing and architecting enterprise applications and solutions, with at least 3+ years in an architect or technical lead role.

* Good to have: knowledge of the wider HR systems landscape, including SAP HCM, payroll, time management and identity/access integration.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline. Architecture certifications (e.g. TOGAF) are a plus; SAP SuccessFactors and OpenText certifications are nice-to-have.
* Excellent communication, leadership and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions, mentor others and interact with stakeholders at all levels.

In the Life Sciences vertical, this role involves partnering with project teams and client stakeholders to discover, design, code, and deploy specialized Salesforce Platform and Industry solutions (including Life Sciences Cloud and Health Cloud) tailored for pharmaceutical, biotech, medtech, and healthcare organizations.

Approximately 7075% of this role involves hands-on programming and system integration using Apex, JavaScript, Lightning Web Components (LWC), OmniStudio, and REST/SOAP APIs, while ensuring compliance with stringent regulatory standards.

The ideal technical consultant is a demonstrated practitioner and emerging thought leader who bridges deep Salesforce development capabilities with domain understanding of regulated industries. You will evaluate implementation options, build scalable architectures, guide client technical teams, proactively manage risk areas, and commit to seeing complex engineering challenges through to resolution.

**What You'll Actually Be Doing**

* Hands-on Development & Customization: Code enterprise-grade solutions using Salesforce Apex, JavaScript, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and modern web frameworks integrated with middleware and core Life Sciences backend systems.
* Domain & Regulatory Solutioning: Implement Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud, and OmniStudio features that comply with strict industry regulatory and security frameworks (e.g., HIPAA, GxP, PHI).
* AI-First Workflow Execution: Champion an AI-first development workflow by leveraging advanced AI developer tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate custom Apex, LWC, and integration delivery while maintaining platform governor limits and security compliance.
* Architecture & Data Modeling: Define and build secure, scalable data models (1:M, M:M relationships), sharing rules, security models, and object structures optimized for Life Sciences and Healthcare workflows.
* Integrations & Interoperability: Build, optimize, and document API-based integrations connecting Salesforce to enterprise platforms, EHR/EMR systems, and middleware standard tools (utilizing HL7/FHIR standards where applicable).
* Technical Leadership & Workshops: Facilitate functional and technical workshops, review user stories, map end-to-end user journeys, and apply modern Apex and UI design patterns to solve complex business requirements.
* Delivery & Best Practices: Adhere to Salesforce Services development best practices, participate in DevOps/release management workflows, and drive high Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) scores.
* Travel: Travel to client sites as required by engagement scope (average of 50%, varying based on project needs).

  

**You're Our Person If...**

* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent.
* 5+ years of technology development experience, with 3+ years in client-facing consulting or system implementation roles.
* Strong object-oriented programming experience (Apex, Java, C#, or Python) alongside fluent JavaScript, HTML/CSS, and web component engineering.
* Proven hands-on experience designing data models, custom logic, and platform integrations on the Salesforce ecosystem.
* Foundational domain awareness of Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Medical Devices, or Healthcare Providers, including exposure to compliance constraints (HIPAA, GxP, PHI).
* Experience with API integrations (REST, SOAP, JSON, XML) and system security protocols.
* Demonstrated ability to analyze complex requirements, design adaptable technical solutions, and work independently as a self-starter.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with client facilitation experience.

  

**Even Better If...**

* Salesforce Product Expertise: Prior development experience with Salesforce Life Sciences Cloud, Health Cloud, OmniStudio framework, or Veeva CRM.
* Healthcare Interoperability: Experience with healthcare data standards and protocols such as HL7 and FHIR.
* Certifications: Highly beneficial to hold existing Salesforce certifications upon joining. Success in this role includes acquiring core certifications within the onboarding phase:Salesforce Certified AdministratorSalesforce Certified Platform App BuilderSalesforce Certified Platform Developer ISalesforce Certified JavaScript Developer ISalesforce Health Cloud Accredited / OmniStudio Developer (Bonus)
* DevOps & Integration Skills: Experience with CI/CD tools, version control (Git), automated testing frameworks, and middleware platforms (e.g., MuleSoft).
* AI Tooling Fluency: Practical experience using AI coding assistants to optimize daily development velocity, document custom code, and automate repetitive engineering tasks.

  

ATTRIBUTES

* Consultative Leader: Ability to clearly communicate the business and technical value of Salesforce platform features to both business stakeholders and client engineering teams.
* Results-Driven: Tenacious and focused on delivering high-quality, maintainable code in fast-paced environments.
* Adaptable Learner: Quick to master emerging platform updates, regulatory guidelines, and AI development techniques.
* Collaborative & Positive: Solves complex multi-system challenges with a constructive, solution-oriented mindset that motivates team members.
