Customers include Coca-Cola, Nestlé, Colgate-Palmolive, Mondelez, Samsung, and Kellogg's. Backed by SoftBank, Insight Partners, and Madrona. Headquartered in Mountain View with teams across the US, India, Canada, and the UK. Pre-IPO.
  
  
**The role**
As a senior technical program manager (STPM), you'll lead our most complex, cross-team and cross-geography programs, such as cloud cost optimization, platform migrations, and large multi-team launches. You'll turn ambiguity into clear plans, keep every team aligned on what matters, and give senior leadership an honest, current view of progress, risks, and trade-offs.
  
  
You'll also be the bridge between executive leadership and engineering. You'll translate business priorities into engineering plans, and translate technical reality into decisions leaders can act on. You won't manage the engineers, but you'll earn their trust and drive results through influence.
  
  
**What you'll do**

* **Lead complex programs end to end.**
  Own programs that span multiple engineering, product, data, and finance teams across time zones, from scoping and planning through launch and post-launch review.
* **Coordinate product and engineering roadmaps.**
  Align product and engineering roadmaps across teams and regions. Reconcile priorities, capacity, and dependencies, keep one integrated view of what ships when, and flag trade-offs early so leadership can make informed calls.
* **Drive cost and efficiency initiatives.**
  Partner with engineering and finance to analyze cloud and infrastructure spend, identify savings, set targets, and track delivery against them.
* **Keep leadership informed.**
  Run regular program reviews and steering committees. Write concise executive updates covering status, milestones, risks, dependencies, decisions needed, and business impact.
* **Bridge executives and engineering.**
  Translate strategy and customer priorities into technical roadmaps and milestones, and explain technical constraints and trade-offs in plain business terms.
* **Manage dependencies and risk.**
  Surface cross-team dependencies early, own the critical path, escalate with clear options and recommendations, and keep the plan honest.
* **Define and track metrics.**
  Set KPIs, SLAs, and success criteria for each program, and report results with data that leaders can trust.
* **Build repeatable ways of working.**
  Improve planning, intake, prioritization, and delivery processes across engineering. Standardize the practices that work.
* **Raise the bar.**
  Mentor program managers and engineering leads, and share best practices across the organization.

**What you'll bring**

* 5+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering management, or a closely related role, including 5+ years leading cross-functional programs with software engineering teams.
* A track record of delivering large, multi-team programs across geographies, with measurable outcomes in scope, schedule, budget, and quality.
* Strong technical depth. You can discuss architecture, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, and CI/CD with engineers and spot risk before it becomes a delay.
* Excellent written and verbal communication. You've presented to VP and C-level audiences and can turn complex detail into a clear story and a clear ask.
* Experience leading cost reduction or efficiency programs, including cloud spend (FinOps), vendor contracts, or resource optimization.
* Proven ability to influence without authority, resolve conflict, and make decisions with incomplete information.
* Comfort with program tooling (Jira, Confluence, or similar) and with building dashboards and reports from engineering and financial data.
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

**Nice to have**

* Background as a software engineer or technical lead.
* Experience at a SaaS, ecommerce, or data and AI company operating at scale.
* Experience with generative AI or agentic AI product development.

**How we'll measure success**

* Programs deliver on agreed scope, timeline, and budget, with risks raised early.
* Cost and efficiency targets are met and tracked transparently.
* Leadership has a current, accurate view of program status and the decisions needed.

**Why CommerceIQ**
You'll work on programs that shape how leading brands win in ecommerce, with direct access to senior leadership and real influence on how engineering operates. We put customers first, communicate clearly, and value people who take ownership.
  
  
*We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other category prohibited by applicable law.*

763c8d15.description:
**We're looking for a**
****Principal Program Manager****
**This role is**
**Office Based, Hyderabad Office**
Cornerstone OnDemand is looking for a Technical Program Manager who will drive the planning, execution, and delivery of complex, cross-functional technical programs. You will work at the intersection of engineering, product, and business teams to ensure large-scale initiatives are delivered with clarity, predictability, and impact. This role requires a strong technical foundation combined with exceptional program management skills to orchestrate multiple workstreams and stakeholders toward shared outcomes.
  
  
**In this role, you will…**
**Program Planning & Execution**

* Own end-to-end program management for large-scale, cross-functional technical initiatives spanning multiple engineering teams, products, and business units.
* Define program scope, milestones, deliverables, success criteria, and resource requirements in collaboration with engineering and product leadership.
* Build and maintain detailed program plans, roadmaps, and schedules with clear dependencies, critical paths, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Drive program execution through structured governance — standups, status reviews, steering committee meetings, and escalation workflows.
* Track and report program health, progress, risks, and blockers to senior leadership and stakeholders through dashboards and executive summaries.
* Manage program-level trade-offs across scope, timeline, quality, and resources — making recommendations grounded in data and technical context.
* Conduct retrospectives and post-mortems to capture lessons learned and drive continuous improvement in delivery processes.
* Identify process bottlenecks and inefficiencies across teams and implement improvements to accelerate delivery cycles.

**Technical Leadership & Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Partner with engineering leaders and architects to understand system designs, technical dependencies, and integration points across programs.
* Facilitate architecture and design reviews to ensure alignment across teams and identify cross-cutting concerns early.
* Coordinate platform migrations, infrastructure upgrades, API versioning, and other technical initiatives that span multiple teams.
* Partner with DevOps and SRE teams to ensure release readiness, deployment coordination, and operational handoffs for program deliverables.
* Define and drive Agile-at-scale practices (SAFe, Scrum of Scrums, or similar) across engineering teams to improve delivery predictability and velocity.
* Facilitate alignment between product roadmaps, engineering capacity, and business priorities to ensure realistic commitments.

**Stakeholder Communication & Risk Management**

* Serve as the central point of communication for program status, decisions, and escalations across engineering, product, design, QA, and business teams.
* Translate complex technical concepts and program details into clear, concise updates for executive leadership and non-technical stakeholders.
* Manage stakeholder expectations proactively — surfacing trade-offs, timeline impacts, and scope changes early with data-backed recommendations.
* Build and maintain a risk management framework — proactively identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks before they become blockers.
* Manage cross-team dependency tracking, capacity planning, and sprint/release coordination.
* Build strong relationships across the organization to enable effective collaboration and influence without authority.

**Requirements**
**You've Got What It Takes If You Have…**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10+ years of experience in technical program management, engineering project management, or a related role within software product organizations.
* 5+ years of hands-on software engineering or technical lead experience (prior to or alongside program management).

6f40aea9.title: Senior Silicon Technical Program Manager
6f40aea9.description:
**Overview**
Microsoft Silicon, Cloud Hardware, and Infrastructure Engineering (SCHIE) is the team behind Microsoft’s expanding Cloud Infrastructure and responsible for powering Microsoft’s “Intelligent Cloud” mission. SCHIE delivers the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's over 200 online businesses including Bing, MSN, Office 365, Xbox Live, Teams, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform globally with our server and data center infrastructure, security and compliance, operations, globalization, and manageability solutions. Our focus is on smart growth, high efficiency, and delivering a trusted experience to customers and partners worldwide and we are looking for engineers to help achieve that mission.
  
  
The Methodology, Infrastructure & Labs Engineering (MILE) team within SCHIE provides the engineering compute infrastructure, computer-aided design (CAD) flows and methods, and labs that Microsoft's silicon teams rely on to design and deliver custom chips. Our team at the India Development Center (IDC) supports two closely linked areas: CAD, which delivers the electronic design automation (EDA) tools, flows and methodologies used by silicon design teams, and Silicon Design Compute Services (SDCS), which runs the high-performance compute, cloud, job scheduling and storage environment those flows depend on, together with managed service partners. As our silicon roadmap grows, we need a Technical Program Manager to drive CAD and SDCS programs to delivery and bring financial rigor to this portfolio.
  
  
As a Technical Program Manager in MILE, you will lead technical programs across our CAD and SDCS portfolios and own budget planning and financial operations for them, so that Microsoft's silicon teams get the tools and compute they need, on time and at the right cost.
  
  
#SCHIE
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead CAD programs end to end, including EDA tool and flow rollouts, version upgrades, methodology changes and license capacity planning for silicon projects, defining scope, milestones, dependencies and success criteria with CAD engineers and design teams.
* Lead SDCS programs for silicon design-compute infrastructure, such as high-performance compute cluster expansions, cloud migration and burst capacity, job scheduler and storage upgrades, and capacity planning against silicon project demand.
* Run program governance across CAD and SDCS: maintain roadmaps, plans and risk and issue logs, drive quarterly planning and objectives and key results (OKRs), and communicate status, risks and decisions clearly to leadership.
* Own end-to-end budget planning, forecasting and tracking for EDA/CAD software licenses, emulation hardware and software, compute infrastructure and vendor services across OPEX, CAPEX and COGS, partnering with Finance on quarterly and annual planning cycles.
* Partner with silicon engineering teams, EDA vendors, Procurement, Finance and managed service providers to align on demand, contracts, purchase orders and service levels, and run regular business and service reviews.
* Support delivery and financial health across the CAD and SDCS portfolio: identify risks, variances and optimization opportunities, drive trade-off decisions with leadership, and represent the programs in planning and executive reviews.
* Define and report metrics for program delivery, spend versus forecast, license and compute utilization, and vendor SLA performance, using data and dashboards to improve cost efficiency, reliability and on-time execution.

**Qualifications**
**Required Qualifications:**

* Required Qualifications Instruction: Qualifications must be pulled from the Role Library and cannot deviate from what is listed.

Bachelor's Degree AND 5+ years experience in engineering, product/technical program management, data analysis, or product development OR equivalent experience.
  
  

* 4+ years experience in cloud Infrastructure, EDA, or CAD, including 2+ years as a project or program manager and a BS(BA) in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Information Systems, a related field.
* Strong understanding of Agile concepts and proven experience applying them in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
* Proficiency with project management tools such as Azure DevOps(ADO), Microsoft Project, Jira, etc.

**Other Requirements**

* Ability to meet Microsoft, customer, and/or government security screening requirements is required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to, the following specialized security screening:
* Microsoft Cloud Background Check. This position is required to pass the Microsoft Cloud Background Check upon hire or transfer and every two years thereafter.
* This role will require access to information that is controlled for export under export control regulations, potentially under the U.S. International Traffic in Arms Regulations or Export Administration Regulations, the EU Dual Use Regulation, and/or other export control regulations.  As a condition of employment, the successful candidate will be required to provide either proof of their country of citizenship or proof of their U.S. permanent residency or other protected status (e.g., under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3)) for assessment of eligibility to access the export-controlled information. To meet this legal requirement, and as a condition of employment, the successful candidate’s citizenship will be verified with a valid passport. Lawful permanent residents, refugees, and asylees may verify status using other documents, where applicable.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with budgeting, financial forecasting and spend management for engineering or IT infrastructure (OPEX/CAPEX), including working with Finance and Procurement on purchase orders and contracts.
* Experience managing EDA/CAD tool and flow deployments, or high-performance compute, job scheduler, storage or cloud infrastructure programs, ideally in a semiconductor design environment.
* Demonstrated ability to communicate clearly with leaders and influence global, cross-functional teams and external vendors without direct authority.
* Experience managing vendors or managed services (statements of work, service reviews, SLA tracking) and proficiency with Excel or Power BI for financial and program reporting.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.
  
  
Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. If you need assistance with religious accommodations and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application process, read more about
**requesting accommodations.**

0970f11f.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
0970f11f.description:
At
**PMGlide**
, we aren’t just building another workflow tool—we are redefining how enterprise software is built and delivered. We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead the execution of complex, 0-to-1 AI initiatives and scale our core platform. If you thrive in ambiguity, possess deep technical intuition, and want to replace legacy project management with autonomous, AI-native execution, you belong here.

**About PMGlide**

PMGlide is an AI-powered automation platform designed to make project delivery predictable,effortless, and highly visible. By deeply integrating advanced Generative AI and automation into the project lifecycle, we eliminate manual toil, mitigate delivery risks before they surface, and give cross-functional teams unprecedented control.We also partner directly with enterprises, providing expert consultation to help them adopt AI-driven engineering and delivery practices.

**The Role**

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, you will be the connective tissue between Engineering, Product, and our enterprise customers. You will not just track milestones; you will drive technical architecture discussions, untangle complex system dependencies, and own the delivery of high-impact AI solutions. Operating as a fully remote leader, you will bring engineering rigor to our program execution, ensuring our AI products scale reliably while delivering immediate business value.

**What You Will Do**

* **Drive 0-to-1 Execution:**
   Lead the end-to-end technical delivery of multi-team, cross-functional programs, turning ambiguous product visions into scalable engineering realities.
* **Architect Alignment:**
   Partner deeply with Engineering and Product Management to evaluate technical feasibility,define system architectures, and ensure programs align with core business objectives.
* **Unblock and Accelerate:**
   Identify and mitigate technical bottlenecks, manage complex API and platform dependencies, and ruthlessly prioritize engineering efforts to maintain high-velocity delivery.
* **Optimize the Machine:**
   Implement lightweight, high-impact processes that scale. Guide distributed engineering teams in adopting modern, AI-focused delivery best practices without introducing corporate bloat.
* **Communicate at Scale:**
   Act as the definitive voice of your programs, translating deep technical complexities into clear, actionable insights for stakeholders, executives, and enterprise clients.

**What You Bring (Minimum Qualifications)**

* **Technical Depth:**
   A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent practical experience. You can comfortably read architecture diagrams, understand distributed systems, and debate technical trade-offs with senior staff engineers.
* **Elite Execution:**
   5+ years of experience in Technical Program Management or Engineering Leadership within fast-paced software development environments (SaaS, Cloud, or AI/ML).
* **Analytical Rigor:**
   Exceptional data fluency. You make evidence-based decisions, define technical KPIs, and continuously optimize program performance.
* **Product Intuition:**
   Demonstrated ability to bridge the gap between engineering execution and user needs, ensuring technical output directly drives product strategy.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Direct experience launching and scaling applied AI, machine learning, or data-heavy SaaS products.
* A proven track record of managing complex software programs across globally distributed, remote-first engineering teams.
* Exceptional executive presence and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence without authority across all levels of an organization.

**How to Apply**

**Instead of a traditional cover letter, we want to see how you think, execute, and communicate. Please submit a**
**single PDF document**
 containing your resume alongside your concise answers (under 500 words each) to the following two questions:

1. **Architectural & Technical Depth:**
    Describe a time you challenged an engineering team's technical or architectural decision. What were the specific trade-offs, and how did you drive the final consensus?
2. **0-to-1 Execution:**
    Walk us through a time you were handed a strategic objective with no clear roadmap or resources. How did you structure the engineering execution and keep the team unblocked?

*(Note: Applications submitted across multiple files or without responses to these questions will not be reviewed.)*

510bc2f3.title: Engineering-Bengaluru-Vice President-Technical Program Manager
510bc2f3.description:
**Job Description**
**What We Do**
At Goldman Sachs, our Engineers don’t just make things – we make things possible. Change the world by connecting people and capital with ideas. Solve the most challenging and pressing engineering problems for our clients. Join our engineering teams that build massively scalable software and systems, architect low latency infrastructure solutions, proactively guard against cyber threats, and leverage machine learning alongside financial engineering to continuously turn data into action. Create new businesses, transform finance, and explore a world of opportunity at the speed of markets.
  
  
Engineering, which is comprised of our Technology Division and global strategists groups, is at the critical center of our business, and our dynamic environment requires innovative strategic thinking and immediate, real solutions. Want to push the limit of digital possibilities? Start here.
  
  
**Who We Look For**
Goldman Sachs Engineers are innovators and problem-solvers, building solutions in risk management, big data, mobile and more. We look for creative collaborators who evolve, adapt to change and thrive in a fast-paced global environment.
  
  
You will act as a force multiplier for Data Platform leadership — translating strategy into a sequenced plan, making the state of the world visible, unblocking engineering teams, and personally executing on the initiatives that matter most. You will break complex, ambiguous problems into steps that teams can act on, adopting the principles of early releases and incremental delivery to generate evidence of value.
  
  
As a Technical Program Manager in Data Engineering, you will:
  
  

* Contribute to one of the most critical Engineering functions at Goldman Sachs.
* Own the roadmap — work with engineering leads to define milestones, sequence dependencies, surface trade-offs, and keep the plan honest as priorities shift.
* Run the commitment book. Maintain a single, trusted view of every major commitment the organization has made — to divisions, to Engineering leadership, to Risk, to Audit, and to regulators — and drive them to closure, escalating early when they are at risk.
* Own the risk book of work. Track and drive remediation of technology risk, control, audit, and regulatory items across the estate; partner with Risk, Compliance, and Engineering leads to ensure obligations are met on time.
* Lead critical cross-cutting programs end to end. Platform migrations, adoption and decommissioning efforts, data model and API rollouts, query engine and performance initiatives, and AI-enablement programs — from framing through delivery and measurable outcome.
* Steward the financials. Support leadership on budget planning and forecasting, headcount and vendor spend, and cloud consumption and cost efficiency for the Lakehouse estate; build the reporting that lets leaders make cost decisions with evidence.
* Support the people agenda. Partner with leadership on organizational planning, hiring pipelines, onboarding, location strategy, engagement, and talent and performance processes.
* Go deep technically. Become a proficient user of the Legend platform; understand our data models, data APIs, connection patterns, and query workloads well enough to challenge assumptions, spot dependencies others miss, and represent the platform credibly to senior stakeholders.
* Use data to run the business. Build and maintain the metrics that describe platform health, adoption, delivery throughput, cost, and user experience.
* Partner with AI initiatives. Help ensure new AI-driven capabilities are delivered in line with the firm's data governance and AI standards.
* Establish robust relationships with our divisional partners and users so that what we build lands with impact, and connect the work of the team to the firm's commercial outcomes.
* Improve how the organization runs — sharpen planning, reporting, and governance rhythms, and shape standards within the firmwide Engineering community.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, or a related technical and/or business discipline, or equivalent practical experience
* 8+ years of technical program or project management experience delivering complex engineering programs, ideally within a data, platform, or infrastructure organization
* Working knowledge of data and cloud fundamentals: strong SQL, relational and analytical databases, data modelling concepts, APIs, and public cloud.
* Demonstrated success partnering with engineering teams to deliver technical outcomes — not just tracking them
* Track record of managing dependencies, risks, and issues across multiple teams, and of driving items to closure without direct authority
* Comfortable with Agile ways of working and with the planning and reporting mechanics that support them
* Demonstrated ability to communicate complex technical problems, plans, and trade-offs clearly to both engineers and senior non-technical stakeholders
* Ability to set goals, meet deadlines and effectively communicate progress to stakeholders
* Exceptional organization and attention to detail — you are the person who holds the thread when nobody else does
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Independent thinker, willing to engage, challenge or learn
* Ability to stay commercially focused and to always push for quantifiable commercial impact
* A healthy obsession with the quality of the platform and the experience of the engineers and users who depend on it, and a willingness to be their internal advocate
* Proven ability to lead by example, with a positive, solutions-oriented attitude
* Strong work ethic, a sense of ownership and urgency

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree or MBA in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* Hands-on exposure to modern Lakehouse and data platform technologies — for example object storage, open table formats (Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake), Spark, Snowflake, Databricks, BigQuery, or comparable
* Familiarity with data modelling and semantic modelling approaches, data APIs, data contracts, and data governance, lineage, and access control concepts
* Understanding of AI and machine learning delivery, including the model development lifecycle, retrieval-augmented generation and LLM-based applications, and the data foundations required to support them
* Scripting or data manipulation skills in Python
* Experience supporting a technology risk, controls, audit, or regulatory book of work
* Prior experience in financial services or another highly regulated, data-intensive environment

**About Goldman Sachs**
At Goldman Sachs, we commit our people, capital and ideas to help our clients, shareholders and the communities we serve to grow. Founded in 1869, we are a leading global investment banking, securities and investment management firm. Headquartered in New York, we maintain offices around the world.
  
  
We believe who you are makes you better at what you do. We're committed to fostering and advancing diversity and inclusion in our own workplace and beyond by ensuring every individual within our firm has a number of opportunities to grow professionally and personally, from our training and development opportunities and firmwide networks to benefits, wellness and personal finance offerings and mindfulness programs. Learn more about our culture, benefits, and people at GS.com/careers.
  
  
We’re committed to finding reasonable accommodations for candidates with special needs or disabilities during our recruiting process. Learn more: https://www.goldmansachs.com/careers/footer/disability-statement.html
  
  
© The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc., 2023. All rights reserved.
  
  
Goldman Sachs is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, veterans status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

f18f3e3d.title: Cybersecurity - Pre-sales (Commission Based)
f18f3e3d.description:
**Company Description**
HackHalt Cyber Intelligence Council is a Section 8 nonprofit organization committed to strengthening global defenses against cybercrime. The organization empowers individuals, businesses, and government bodies to operate safely in the digital world through a four-pillar strategy of Prevention, Education, Detection, and Rapid Response. By advancing AI-driven cyber technologies and conducting cutting-edge research, HackHalt focuses on anticipating and mitigating emerging threats. Supported by 40+ global partners and having trained over 10,000 individuals by 2026, the council is actively building a resilient, skilled cyber workforce. The environment offers mission-driven work for professionals who want to contribute to safer, more secure digital ecosystems worldwide.
  
  
**Role Description**
  
This is a full-time, remote Cybersecurity Pre-sales role with a commission-based compensation structure. The role involves engaging prospective clients to understand their cybersecurity challenges and mapping those needs to HackHalt’s solutions and services. Day-to-day responsibilities include conducting discovery calls, preparing and delivering technical and business-focused presentations, and supporting solution demonstrations for areas such as application, network, and information security. The position also requires creating proposal documents, collaborating with technical and delivery teams to refine solution designs, and contributing to sales strategies aligned with the organization’s four-pillar security framework. The individual will maintain accurate records of client interactions, provide input on market trends, and help build long-term relationships that support sustainable growth in cybersecurity services.
  
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong foundational knowledge in Cybersecurity and Information Security, with the ability to explain concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Hands-on understanding of Application Security and related secure development or code review practices.
* Knowledge of Network Security principles, architectures, and common protective measures (e.g., firewalls, IDS/IPS, VPNs).
* Familiarity with broader cyber threat landscapes (“Cyber”), including threat intelligence, incident response, and risk management.
* Experience in pre-sales, solutions consulting, or technical sales, preferably in cybersecurity or IT services.
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to build trust and long-term client relationships.
* Comfort working on a commission-based structure, with a results-oriented approach and ability to work independently in a remote setting.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience; relevant certifications (e.g., Security+, CEH, CISSP, or similar) are an advantage.

971d307a.title: Principal Solution Architect
971d307a.description:
**What makes us Qlik?**
A Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ Leader for 16 years in a row, Qlik helps teams get more out of AI with trusted data products, a powerful analytics engine, and AI agents. This helps teams reduce risk and operating costs, while scaling AI responsibly.
  
  
Used by 75% of the Fortune 500, Qlik works with the systems organizations already use, maintaining flexibility without lock-in.
  
  
**The Principal Solution Architect Role**
Are you ready to take the lead in shaping the future of data and analytics? As a Senior Solution Architect, you’ll be the go-to technical expert, guiding some of the largest customers and partners in the India region. You’ll be at the forefront of demonstrating how cutting-edge data integration and analytics solutions can drive real business transformation.
  
  
Collaborating closely with a dynamic Presales team in a flexible, agile environment, you’ll have the opportunity to showcase your expertise while working with Sales, Marketing, R&D, Product, Consulting, and Customer Success teams. If you're looking for a role that is engaging, fast-paced, and full of opportunities to make an impact, this is it.
  
  
**What makes this role interesting?**

* Engage with high-profile customers and partners: Lead technical discussions and showcase innovative solutions to help organizations unlock the true power of their data.
* Drive business success with cutting-edge technology: Leverage Qlik’s next-generation data analytics and data integration platform to solve complex business challenges.
* Be at the forefront of industry trends: Stay ahead of the game by keeping up with the latest advancements in data analytics, as well as the competitive landscape.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams: Work closely with internal teams and experts across Sales, Marketing, R&D, and Customer Success to build compelling solutions that resonate with customers.
* Flexibility and agility: Thrive in an environment that values adaptability, innovation, and dynamic thinking.

**Here’s How You’ll Be Making An Impact**

* Own the technical sales cycle: Become a trusted advisor by guiding customers through technical evaluations, ensuring a seamless journey from exploration to adoption.
* Showcase innovation through tailored solutions: Deliver compelling presentations and custom demonstrations that address real customer needs and business challenges.
* Prove value through successful Proof-of-Concepts: Help customers experience the true power of Qlik’s platform by leading impactful proof-of-concept engagements.
* Support business development efforts: Play a key role in driving regional revenue growth by supporting strategic sales initiatives and expanding Qlik’s presence in the market.
* Position solutions for long-term success: Communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, from technical teams to senior leadership, ensuring alignment on the value and impact of Qlik’s solutions.

* Strong experience in Data Integration (ETL), Data Quality (DQ), Data Governance, iPaaS (APIs, micro services, Application Integration) will be plus
* Good understanding of SQL & data modeling.
* Good understanding of Machine Learning tools and its usage such as Python/R, and other AI/ML and Gen AI technologies
* Familiarity with cloud platforms and services
* Good to have Knowledge of BI & analytics tools like Qlik Sense etc.
* Excellent communication skills to the business as well as technical audience
* Highly driven with strong interpersonal skills
* Track record of developing relationships at technical, commercial, and executive levels throughout large enterprises
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple complex opportunities.

53bf8952.title: Solution Engineer

As a Solution Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, demonstrating, and implementing enterprise-level SaaS, chatbot, conversational AI, and CPaaS solutions for clients. * Work with JavaScript, C++, .NET, and related technologies to customize and integrate client solutions.
* Collaborate with Sales and Customer Success teams to define client needs, solution scope, effort estimates, dependencies, and delivery expectations.
* Partner with Product and Engineering teams to assess feasibility, resolve technical issues, and provide client feedback.

* Contribute to internal knowledge sharing, best-practice documentation, technical mentorship, and the development of reusable solution assets.

**Required Qualifications And Skills**

* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum 3 years of experience in solution engineering, technical consulting, systems development, enterprise software implementation, or a related role.
* Demonstrated experience in a customer-facing role, including the ability to communicate confidently, present solutions, influence stakeholders, and handle client discussions independently.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools such as Claude, Codex, ChatGPT, or similar platforms to build solutions, prototypes, code, workflows, or other technical artifacts.
* Practical experience with chatbot technologies, conversational AI, generative AI, or conversational agent solutions.
* Proficiency in one or more of JavaScript, C++, and .NET, along with the ability to understand and work across multiple technologies.
* Strong knowledge of API integrations, particularly REST APIs, Call APIs, webhooks, and third-party service integrations.
* Experience with SaaS products and enterprise-level implementations.
* Familiarity with CPaaS products such as Email, Voice, WhatsApp, RCS, and marketing automation platforms.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to convert business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Ability to work collaboratively with Sales, Customer Success, Product, Engineering, and other cross-functional teams.
* Experience with Agile methodologies is an advantage.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Why you'll love it here**

* Financial rewards & recognition - A fair compensation aligned with your experience, industry, and market standards, performance-driven bonuses, regular reviews to support your growth and recognize your contributions, and a culture that values your impact.
* Flexible work arrangements - We combine in-person collaboration with remote work and flexible working hours, because great ideas happen everywhere - and not always between 9 and 5.
* ESOP (Employee Stock Ownership Plan) - As an Infobip employee, you’ll have the opportunity to share in our company’s success through stock options.
* Work-life balance and Well-being  - We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
* Career mobility - Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
* Professional development - Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow - no matter where you start.
* International mobility - Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well-being, and success - wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection

**Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.**
We’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.
  
  
No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.

* Operational Support: Assist in performing performance testing, security hardening, and routine compliance checks on deployed solutions.
* Troubleshooting: Provide technical support to resolve configuration issues and connectivity problems between cloud and on-premises systems.

* Asset Creation: Assist in updating and maintaining OCI-based reusable assets, reference architectures, and solution templates.
* Documentation: Contribute to the creation of technical documentation, including low-level design (LLD) documents, network diagrams, and deployment checklists.

* Teamwork: Work closely with delivery teams and senior architects to ensure project tasks are completed within the defined timelines.
* Knowledge Sharing: Participate in technical knowledge-sharing sessions to stay updated on the latest OCI features and best practices.
  

**Key skills required:**

  

* Education : Any Bachelor’s or Master’s degree.
* 3–7 years of experience in cloud or infrastructure roles, with at least 2 years of hands-on experience with OCI.
* Practical knowledge of OCI core services (Compute, Storage, Networking).
* Proficiency with IaC tools (Terraform) and scripting languages (Python or Bash).
* Basic understanding of multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to follow technical design specifications accurately.

Good to have

* OCI Foundations or OCI Architect Associate certification.
* Experience with cloud security basics and networking (VPN, Security Lists).
* Familiarity with Linux administration and shell scripting.

0234f017.description:
**Introduction**
A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.
  
  
**Your Role And Responsibilities**
As a Package Consultant specializing in SAP Cloud Integration, you will design, implement, and configure SAP Cloud Integration solutions for clients, focusing on analyzing business requirements and ensuring successful project delivery. You will work closely with clients, project managers, and other team members to understand business needs and develop solutions that meet client requirements.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include**

* Design SAP Cloud Integration Solutions: Analyze business requirements and design SAP Cloud Integration solutions to meet client needs, including configuring and implementing SAP Cloud Integration modules such as API Management, Integration Flow, and Cloud Connector.
* Implement and Test Solutions: Configure and implement SAP Cloud Integration solutions, perform unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure solution quality.
* Collaborate with Clients and Team Members: Work closely with clients, project managers, and other team members to ensure successful project delivery and provide training and support to clients on SAP Cloud Integration functionality and best practices.
* Maintain Technical Documentation: Develop and maintain technical documentation, including configuration documents and testing scripts.
* Stay Up-to-Date with SAP Cloud Integration: Stay current with SAP Cloud Integration releases, patches, and new features, and apply this knowledge to client projects.

**Preferred Education**
Master's Degree
  
  
**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**

* Exposure to SAP Cloud Integration: Experience with designing, implementing, and configuring SAP Cloud Integration solutions, including analyzing business requirements and ensuring successful project delivery.
* Knowledge of SAP Cloud Integration Modules: Experience with configuring and implementing SAP Cloud Integration modules, such as API Management, Integration Flow, and Cloud Connector.
* Testing and Quality Assurance: Experience with performing unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) to ensure solution quality.
* Technical Documentation: Experience with developing and maintaining technical documentation, including configuration documents and testing scripts.
* SAP Cloud Integration Releases and Features: Experience with staying up-to-date with SAP Cloud Integration releases, patches, and new features, and applying this knowledge to client projects.

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**

* SAP Cloud Integration Releases: Exposure to staying current with SAP Cloud Integration releases, patches, and new features, and applying this knowledge to client projects.
* SAP Systems Integration: Experience with integrating SAP Cloud Integration with other SAP systems, such as SAP ERP, SAP CRM, and SAP BW.
* API Management Knowledge: Exposure to configuring and implementing API Management as part of SAP Cloud Integration solutions.

7436687c.title: Senior F5 Consultant – Service Provider & Cloud Native Solutions
7436687c.description:
**Location:**
India

**Experience:**
6+ Years

**F5 Certification:**
F5 CA (101 & 201) Mandatory

**Travel:**
Candidate should be open to customer-site travel as required

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Senior F5 Consultant with strong expertise across F5 BIG-IP, Service Provider networking, Kubernetes/OpenShift, and cloud-native infrastructure.

The consultant will work closely with customers to design, implement, troubleshoot, and optimize F5 solutions across enterprise and Service Provider environments. The role requires a strong combination of traditional F5 expertise and modern containerized / cloud-native networking experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide technical consulting for implementation, configuration, and maintenance of F5 BIG-IP solutions.
* Design and support complex application delivery and networking solutions across enterprise and Service Provider environments.
* Work on F5 BIG-IP CGNAT solutions for IPv4 address preservation and IPv6 transition.
* Design, implement, and troubleshoot BIG-IP DNS / GTM solutions for high availability, performance, and secure DNS services.
* Support containerized and cloud-native environments using Kubernetes and OpenShift.
* Implement and support F5 solutions such as Container Ingress Services (CIS) and Cloud-Native Network Functions (CNF).
* Work with Docker images, YAML configurations, deployment plans, and Kubectl.
* Support provisioning and management of container clusters.
* Perform solution architecture, design, deployment, testing, troubleshooting, and technical documentation.
* Work on routing and networking technologies including BGP, OSPF, IPv4, IPv6, TCP, and UDP.
* Troubleshoot complex application, network, DNS, SSL/TLS, security, and load-balancing issues.
* Work directly with customers and internal technical teams during implementation and migration projects.
* Prepare technical documentation, implementation plans, status updates, and solution recommendations.

**Mandatory Skills**

* Minimum 6+ years of relevant experience in network / systems infrastructure, architecture, design, or application delivery.
* Strong hands-on experience with F5 BIG-IP.
* Strong experience with LTM and GTM / BIG-IP DNS.
* Hands-on experience with Kubernetes / K8s.

The gTech Ads organization has established a new Agency and Partners (gAP) Organization with a mission to scale gTech's expert services to thousands of advertisers through a thriving partner ecosystem. By empowering our partners to become a powerful extension of our own gTech service capabilities, we will help more customers succeed with Google.

As a Partner Delivery Manager (PDM), you are the single-threaded owner and strategic orchestrator for a portfolio of Google's most critical third-party partners. Your will sit at the heart of our new gAP Organization and be responsible for owning the end-to-end delivery lifecycle, from strategic planning and technical readiness assessment to delivery governance and performance management, for partners. You will act as the crucial, senior-level solutions and enablement bridge between Google and the C-suite of our partners. This role is a hybrid of strategy, deep technical expertise, and operational program management, requiring you to define the delivery strategy for your market/product area, carry the activation goals for your partners, and ensure they are motivated, capable, and equipped to scale the delivery of Google's advertising solutions. Your work is critical to expanding our service reach and helping our mutual customers grow.

Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.

08318264.title: Principal, Technical Program Manager
08318264.description:
About TeamGDF sits at the core of Walmart's AI & Data organization, building the foundational data platforms that make it possible for every team at Walmart — technical or non-technical — to build with trustworthy, well-governed, discoverable data. Our platforms serve billions of transactions and interactions across 19 countries, powering everything from supply chain intelligence to customer-facing personalization to enterprise AI agents. This particular team is newly formed to solve one of GDF's next big platform bets — which means you'll be shaping charter, operating model, and delivery cadence essentially from a blank page, not inheriting someone else's playbook.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
Serve as the founding TPM for a newly created platform team — standing up program structure, delivery cadence, and governance where none previously existed.
  
  
Manage large, cross-cutting software/platform development programs end-to-end, partnering closely with architects and engineering leaders on architectural decision-making.
  
  
Define goals, stage gates, critical delivery paths, and key deliverables for programs spanning multiple workstreams, dependencies, timelines, and resource constraints.
  
  
Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships across GDF, AI & Data, and downstream consuming teams — driving alignment on roles, responsibilities, and delivery cadences.
  
  
Establish a resource capacity allocation process and tooling to bring planning rigor to a fast-moving, newly formed org.
  
  
Drive efficient engineering resource utilization; simplify and clarify priorities into plans with milestones suitable for advance planning and executive buy-in.
  
  
Identify and champion AI-augmented program management practices — e.g., using AI to auto-summarize status updates, flag at-risk milestones from ticket/PR signal, or generate stakeholder-ready reporting — and work with tooling/eng leads to actually implement them.
  
  
Navigate setbacks and ambiguity with strong problem-solving and decision-making skills — this is a 0→1 team, so comfort operating without a fully paved path is essential.
  
  
Represent the platform team in leadership/executive reviews, translating technical delivery status into business-relevant narrative.
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent; 15+ years of overall technical experience, including 10+ years in a Technical Program Management leadership role delivering software programs with aggressive schedules and significant business impact.
  
  
Proven experience standing up new programs/teams from scratch — comfortable defining process, cadence, and governance rather than just operating within an existing one.
  
  
Strong leadership skills, with the ability to effectively manage and motivate a team of technical program managers and engineers.
  
  
Experience supporting and executing a large software/platform portfolio while collaborating with multiple business stakeholders.
  
  
Solid grounding in system/platform design concepts, architecture, technical design, services, APIs, and data platform technologies (data pipelines, lakehouse architectures, governance frameworks).
  
  
AI-forward program management skillset:Practical experience using GenAI tools (e.g., Copilot-style assistants, internal LLM platforms) to accelerate program artifacts — status reports, risk summaries, requirement drafts, meeting-notes-to-action-items.
  
  
Familiarity with AI-assisted meeting intelligence (e.g., auto-transcription/summarization of Teams/Zoom calls) and using it to close the loop on decisions and action items faster.
  
  
Working understanding of how AI/ML and agentic systems get built and deployed (MLOps basics, model lifecycle, data quality dependencies) — enough to program-manage platform work that directly enables AI use cases.
  
  
Curiosity and judgment to identify where AI genuinely helps a program (signal, not noise) versus where it's a distraction.
  
  
Ability to build positive relationships with product managers, translating target personas and business needs into features/user stories engineers can act on.
  
  
Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a love for data and solving complex, ambiguous problems.
  
  
Expertise in change & risk management methodologies, project tracking tools, dashboards, and executive reporting.
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communicator — equally adept communicating upward, outward, and downward.
  
  
Deep hands-on familiarity with JIRA, JIRA Align, Big Picture, Airtable, or equivalent program tooling.
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, PTO, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
  
  
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." By fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
  
  
Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
Walmart, Inc., is an Equal Opportunities Employer – By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.

b3e2945c.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
b3e2945c.description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Principal Technical Program Manager
  
  
Mastercard Networks Exchange is an intelligent and scalable offering that enables transaction originators and receivers to link to different
  
  
networks in the end-to-end transaction flow with just a single connection.
  
  
This one connection to global and regional payment rails reduces the cost and complications of managing individual connections to
  
  
multiple networks. As a trusted connectivity partner, Mastercard Networks Exchange presents a unified approach to help customers achieve economics of scale.
  
  
NEX is on a transformational modernization journey, building a next-generation platform that is highly scalable, resilient, and configurable to meet the evolving needs of our growing customer base. This modern foundation will enable faster innovation, improved reliability, and greater operational efficiency as we continue to expand our capabilities.
  
  
**About The Role**
Drives execution of an outcome from inception through successful delivery of the services or domains, or an outcome that spans multiple teams and integrations across the enterprise
  
  
Works with multiple scrum/delivery teams to build/improve ways of working and identify and mitigate risks or issues that may impact the plan
  
  
Conducts meaningful retrospectives, creates action plans to implement changes at the team level; coordinates with other TPMs in the program to align and plan potential actions to be implemented across the program
  
  
Looks across the program to identify potential system efficiencies or process improvements, and suggests proactive strategies for consideration by program leadership
  
  
Clearly articulate scope, timelines, dependencies, owners, actions, risks, and mitigations. Report progress to teams and senior leadership in regular cadence, potentially representing segments of or the entire program
  
  
Looked to as first point of contact for your teams or business line/service and the source of truth for status, providing the correct information and associated data about the state of the project to the right audience at the right time with the right focus
  
  
Understands the business strategy and design approaches within product, program, or domain with depth to be credible and influential with teams they work with
  
  
**All About You**
Experience operating autonomously across multiple teams, demonstrated critical thinking, and thought leadership
  
  
Experience in building large scale enterprise technical or engineering programs and products from inception to delivery and experience articulating the impact using metrics.
  
  
Demonstrated experience breaking down problems, organizing work, planning sprints, and delivering technical programs in agile delivery models (scrum, Kanban, etc.)
  
  
Help customers and the engineering teams make trade-off decisions by considering all data including business goals, technical platform strategy, customer experience and maintainability. You identify blocking issues and manage their resolution.
  
  
Proven track record of data-driven decision making and applying continuous improvement methodologies across teams
  
  
Demonstrated experience building relationships, partnering with and influencing dependent teams while commanding the respect of the individuals you work with across the organization
  
  
Expertise in Payments, IaaS, PaaS, huge plus if you have expertise in CI/CD, SQL databases, microservices APIs, and distributed systems operations in a DevOps model are a plus
  
  
Technical program delivery experience
  
  
Self-motivated, intellectually curious, and ownership-driven leader who proactively identifies opportunities, challenges assumptions, and drives outcomes end-to-end. Demonstrates a builder's mindset, taking initiative to solve complex business and technical problems rather than operating as an order taker.
  
  
**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.
  
  
**So, what’s the role all about?**
As a Program Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing multiple projects and initiatives that support the organization's strategic goals. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project execution, on-time delivery, and adherence to quality standards.
  
  
**How will you make an impact?**

* Ensure adherence to project management methodologies, standards, and best practices, and continuously improve project management processes and tools

* Champion an AI-augmented approach to program management – using AI tools to synthesize program signals, draft stakeholder communications, and automate reporting and risk analysis, evolving the role from status coordination to program intelligence.

+ Strong understanding of project management methodologies, tools, and techniques
+ Proven track record of successfully managing multiple projects and initiatives simultaneously.

* Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills

* Demonstrated hands-on use of AI tools (e.g. Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) in your own program management workflow – reporting, risk analysis, stakeholder communications – not just familiarity with AI as a product feature.
* Hands-on knowledge & experience on-

+ Software Development & Quality - Processes & standards
+ Release Management
+ Pre & Post-Production Product Launches
+ Hands on exp on Atlassian Tools (JIRA/Confluence),
+ AI-assisted reporting, automation, and agentic workflows (e.g. building prompts or lightweight agents to support planning, risk tracking, or stakeholder updates)

+ Cloud- AWS,
+ DevOps practices

* PMP certification preferred.

**What’s in it for you?**
Join an ever-growing, market disrupting, global company where the teams – comprised of the best of the best – work in a fast-paced, collaborative, and creative environment! As the market leader, every day at NICE is a chance to learn and grow, and there are endless internal career opportunities across multiple roles, disciplines, domains, and locations. If you are passionate, innovative, and excited to constantly raise the bar, you may just be our next NICEr!
  
  
**Enjoy NICE-FLEX!**
At NICE, we work according to the NICE-FLEX hybrid model, which enables maximum flexibility: 2 days working from the office and 3 days of remote work, each week. Naturally, office days focus on face-to-face meetings, where teamwork and collaborative thinking generate innovation, new ideas, and a vibrant, interactive atmosphere.

9f66fe55.description:
Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following:
**Mumbai, Maharashtra, India; Gurugram, Haryana, India**
.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in a technical project management or a customer-facing role.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Master’s degree in Business, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering or Applied Science, or a related field.
* Experience in programmatically scaling services and partner capabilities in a global context.
* Understanding of Google’s advertising solutions (e.g., Measurement, Ads), the broader media landscape, and enterprise sales dynamics.
* Ability to drive business outcomes through strategic planning, negotiation of commercial incentives, and executive-level influence.
* Ability to bridge sales, partner needs, and engineering teams by identifying high-value, advanced technology integration use cases, driving co-development opportunities from discovery to activation, and quantifying the downstream business results.

**About The Job**
The gTech Ads organization has established a new Agency and Partners (gAP) Organization with a mission to scale gTech's expert services to thousands of advertisers through a thriving partner ecosystem. By empowering our partners to become a powerful extension of our own gTech service capabilities, we will help more customers succeed with Google.
  
  
As a Partner Delivery Manager (PDM), you are the single-threaded owner and strategic orchestrator for a portfolio of Google's most critical third-party partners. Your will sit at the heart of our new gAP Organization and be responsible for owning the end-to-end delivery lifecycle, from strategic planning and technical readiness assessment to delivery governance and performance management, for partners. You will act as the crucial, senior-level solutions and enablement bridge between Google and the C-suite of our partners. This role is a hybrid of strategy, deep technical expertise, and operational program management, requiring you to define the delivery strategy for your market/product area, carry the activation goals for your partners, and ensure they are motivated, capable, and equipped to scale the delivery of Google's advertising solutions. Your work is critical to expanding our service reach and helping our mutual customers grow.
  
  
Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.
  
  
To learn more about gTech, check out our video .
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage technical delivery of advertising solutions for key agency partners to drive business growth.
* Lead complex, cross-functional projects to optimize operational workflows and improve support efficiency.
* Consult with senior agency stakeholders to identify technical integration needs and provide strategic recommendations.
* Drive adoption of advanced advertising products and features across partner portfolios.
* Resolve critical technical escalations from partner agencies to maintain high levels of client satisfaction.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.

**Your Role**

A Traditional and Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure Solution Specialist is a practitioner in the field of Solution Architecture and will be working within the Cloud Infrastructure Outsourcing Solutioning team. The Data Center and Network Managed Services Solution Architect is a very experienced architect with cross-domain, cross-functional, and cross-industry expertise. He/she outlines solution architecture descriptions, then monitors and governs their specification and costing during a sales campaign. Must have performed roles in infrastructure management and Presales, design/architect infrastructure solutions for managed services. Experience in architecting solutions, FTE sizing, hosting solution estimation, hardware sizing, cloud resource sizing, cost models and responding to RFPs for infrastructure management Outsourcing Services.

• Build the costing details for the run solution

• Present the solution to the customer during workshops, oral sessions

• Manage and mitigate the risks associated with the proposed solution

• Follow solution approval process

Business Development

• Manages presales and solutioning activities for the service offering

• Build and maintain cost models

• Create winning proposals by closely working with Bid Managers, onsite sales teams, internal delivery organizations, 3rd party vendors

• Build (and maintain repository) for costing models, proposals, and business development documents

• Mentor and guide junior Solution Architect resources

**Your Profile**

• Operational and service delivery experience in the following streams with in-depth domain expertise in any of the following streams:

o Traditional IT Infrastructure including on-premises data center, network, database, middleware, storage, backup

o SDI Platform: VxRail, Nutanix, Hyperflex, vSAN, NSX. Converged Platform: Synergy, VxBlock, Flexpod Soln's

o Migration Solution – Cloud Natives, Storage based Replication, Zerto, Platespin. Compute Virtualization: VMware, Hyper-V, Acropolis

o Backup Soln - Rubrik, Cohesity, Commvault, Networker, Spectrum. Hybrid Storage Arrays: Dell-EMC, HPE, Nimble, Pure & IBM

o Storage Virtualization & Fabric: VPLEX, SVC, Cisco & Brocade Switching. DRaaS Soln - VMWare SRM, IBM CRO & Zerto

o Middleware - IIS, WebSphere, WebLogic, JBoss, etc. Remote monitoring and management tools (Tivoli, BMC, HPOV, CA Spectrum, etc.)

o Automation- UiPath, Ansible, Jenkins, Microfocus

o ITSM- ServiceNow, Remedy. Network Knowledge - Cisco, Avaya, F5, and Juniper, Citrix, SDWAN, SDN

• Proven track record of having done customer-facing solution defense.

• Team player and self-motivated individual. Proficient (read, write, speak) in the English language

• Strong communication skills to listen to the clients and articulate back for solutioning

**What you'll love about working here**

* You can shape your career with us. We offer a range of career paths and internal opportunities within Capgemini group. You will also get personalized career guidance from our leaders.
* You will get comprehensive wellness benefits including health checks, telemedicine, insurance with top-ups, elder care, partner coverage or new parent support via flexible work.
* At Capgemini, you can work on cutting-edge projects in tech and engineering with industry leaders or create solutions to overcome societal and environmental challenges.

Capgemini is a global business and technology transformation partner, helping organizations to accelerate their dual transition to a digital and sustainable world, while creating tangible impact for enterprises and society. It is a responsible and diverse group of 340,000 team members in more than 50 countries. With its strong over 55-year heritage, Capgemini is trusted by its clients to unlock the value of technology to address the entire breadth of their business needs. It delivers end-to-end services and solutions leveraging strengths from strategy and design to engineering, all fueled by its market leading capabilities in AI, generative AI, cloud and data, combined with its deep industry expertise and partner ecosystem.

7b1dee3d.title: Solution Architect
7b1dee3d.description:
**What You’ll Do**
The Solution Architect will be the technical partner to the B-Line Sales Manager and will develop complete, application-based solutions across the B-Line portfolio. The role will engage customers from concept and design through specification, BOQ development, technical submittal, approval and project execution, helping Eaton move from individual product selling to integrated, specification-led solution selling.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop end-to-end, application-based solutions across the complete Eaton B-Line portfolio, translating project requirements into optimized product architecture, BOQs and technical proposals.
* Provide customer-facing pre-sales application engineering for Data Centers, Premium Real Estate, Commercial and Institutional Buildings, Industrial Construction, Infrastructure and advanced manufacturing projects.
* Review architectural, electrical and MEP drawings, specifications and tender documents; prepare and validate BOQs, product selections, loading requirements, configurations and accessories.
* Lead technical engagement with architects, MEP/electrical consultants, data center designers, developers, end users, general contractors, EPCs and electrical/MEP contractors.
* Develop and influence project specifications, standard details, approved makes, vendor approvals and repeatable solution architectures before the RFQ/tender stage.
* Prepare technical compliance statements, deviations and clarifications, datasheet packages, typical installation drawings, selection schedules and complete technical submittals.
* Provide value engineering and competitive conversion proposals that improve installation productivity, reduce site fabrication and lower total installed cost.
* Build strong application expertise across wire mesh trays, ladder and cable tray systems, strut/channel systems, mechanical supports, fasteners, accessories, equipment supports and data center cable pathways.
* Partner with the Sales Manager on joint customer visits, opportunity qualification, technical presentations, solution configuration, technical negotiations and project conversion.
* Support projects through concept, design, specification, BOQ, tender, technical approval, order and installation; provide site guidance and resolve application issues during execution.
* Conduct product seminars, consultant workshops and training for customers, channel partners, contractors and internal sales teams.
* Capture voice of customer and collaborate with product management and engineering on portfolio gaps, localization, tools and application literature.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering.
* 6-8 years of relevant experience in cable management, electrical support systems, MEP systems, construction products, data-center infrastructure, application engineering or technical sales.

**Skills**

* Experience supporting large projects from design and specification through technical approval and execution.
* Experience engaging consultants, contractors and end users in the Indian construction market.
* Willingness and ability to travel regularly across India.
* Experience combining customer-facing technical sales with application engineering. Hands-on knowledge of wire mesh trays, ladder trays, cable trays, strut/channel systems, mechanical supports and related accessories
* Experience with Data Center cable pathways, support structures, high-density routing and modular installation solutions.
* Familiarity with relevant Indian and international standards and project submittal practices.
* CAD/BIM design and drawing discipline
